Walney Extension.de: 40 MHI Vestas V164-8.25 (164 m rotor) plus 47 Siemens Gamesa SWT-7.0-154 (154 m rotor, NS Energy); rotor diameter is the larger model; Ofgem transfer presentation: water depth 21–37 m LAT; Ørsted’s opening release gives sea level to blade tip 188 m (154 m rotor) and 195 m (164 m rotor), so hub heights are derived as tip height minus rotor radius, about 111 m / 113 m.

West of Duddon Sands.dz: 水深 17–24 m、Siemens SWT 3.6-120 輪轂 90 m、葉輪 120 m（德文維基百科）。
West of Duddon Sands.de: Water depth 17–24 m; Siemens SWT 3.6-120, hub 90 m, rotor 120 m (German Wikipedia).

Westermost Rough.dz: 水深約 15 m（英文維基百科英國離岸風場清單列）；35 座 Siemens SWT-6.0-154，輪轂高度 102 m（平均海面起算，Green Investment Group 施工圖輯）；葉輪直徑 154 m（英文維基百科）。
Westermost Rough.de: Water depth about 15 m (en.wikipedia UK offshore wind farm list row); 35 Siemens SWT-6.0-154 with hub height 102 m above mean sea level (Green Investment Group construction photo brochure); rotor diameter 154 m (en.wikipedia).

Borkum Riffgrund 3.dz: 單樁基礎安裝水深 28–34 公尺（Power Technology）；SG 11.0-200 葉輪直徑 200 公尺（Siemens Gamesa 新聞稿）；輪轂高度：BSH 核准公告寫 83 座、輪轂 142 m、葉輪 200 m（與實裝機型一致），德國市場主資料登錄（wetterchen.de 逐機清單）寫 142.4 m，取登錄值。
Borkum Riffgrund 3.de: Monopiles installed in 28–34 m of water (Power Technology); SG 11.0-200 rotor diameter 200 m (Siemens Gamesa press release); hub height: the BSH planning approval gives 83 turbines with 142 m hub and 200 m rotor (matching the installed model) and the German market register (wetterchen.de per-turbine list) gives 142.4 m, which is used.

Hohe See.zh: OSPAR 只寫「任一種」、德文維基百科也沒寫；施工新聞：與相鄰的 Albatros 共 87 部風機全用單樁
Hohe See.en: OSPAR says “any of these” and German Wikipedia does not say; construction news: all 87 turbines of Hohe See and neighbouring Albatros stand on monopiles
Hohe See.dz: 水深約 40 公尺（德文維基百科）；SWT-7.0-154 葉輪直徑 154 公尺、輪轂高度 105 公尺（Power Technology）。
Hohe See.de: Water depth about 40 m (German Wikipedia); SWT-7.0-154 rotor diameter 154 m and hub height 105 m (Power Technology).

Hooksiel (BARD test turbine).zh: BARD 的三樁試驗機（2016 年拆除）
Hooksiel (BARD test turbine).dz: BARD 在 Hooksiel 外海 Außenjade 的單部 5 MW 試驗機：Nordwest-Zeitung（2008-09-10，豎立期間）稱這部「Bard VM」輪轂高 90 m、葉輪直徑將近 122 m；Modern Power Systems（2008-09）寫輪轂在水面上 90 m、葉輪 122 m；同刊 2009-01（運轉後）與 Renewable Energy World（2008-11 落成報導）稱裝在水深 2～8 m 處。輪轂高度的出處都是施工期間的報導（不是事後竣工文件）。
Hooksiel (BARD test turbine).de: BARD's single 5 MW test turbine in the outer Jade off Hooksiel: Nordwest-Zeitung (10 Sep 2008, during erection) gives this 'Bard VM' a 90 m hub height and a rotor of just under 122 m; Modern Power Systems (Sep 2008) gives a hub 90 m above water level and a 122 m rotor; the same magazine (Jan 2009, after start-up) and Renewable Energy World (Nov 2008 inauguration report) put it in 2–8 m of water. The hub-height sources are construction-time reports, not a post-completion document.

EnBW Baltic 1.dz: 水深 16–19 公尺、輪轂高度 67 公尺（水面起算）、葉輪直徑 93 公尺（德文維基百科，Siemens SWT-2.3-93）。
EnBW Baltic 1.de: Water depth 16–19 m, hub height 67 m above water, rotor diameter 93 m (German Wikipedia; Siemens SWT-2.3-93).

EnBW Baltic 2.zh: 水深約 35 m 以內用單樁（39 座），更深處用套管（41 座）
EnBW Baltic 2.en: Monopiles in water up to about 35 m deep (39) and jackets beyond (41)
EnBW Baltic 2.dz: 水深 23–44 公尺（EnBW 官網）；SWT-3.6-120 輪轂高度水面上 78.25 公尺、葉輪直徑 120 公尺（德文維基百科）。
EnBW Baltic 2.de: Water depth 23–44 m (EnBW site); SWT-3.6-120 hub height 78.25 m above water and rotor diameter 120 m (German Wikipedia).

Wikinger.dz: 水深約 32–42 公尺、Adwen AD 5-135 葉輪直徑 135 公尺、總高 165 公尺（德文維基百科）；輪轂高度查無可引用出處（塔筒約 75 公尺）；德文維基百科：風機高 165 m、葉輪直徑 135 m（AD 5-135），輪轂高 ≈ 165 − 67.5 = 97.5 m；輪轂高度由葉尖高減葉輪半徑推算
Wikinger.de: Water depth about 32–42 m, Adwen AD 5-135 rotor diameter 135 m, total height 165 m (German Wikipedia); no quotable hub height (tower about 75 m); German Wikipedia: turbines 165 m tall with a 135 m rotor (AD 5-135); hub ≈ 165 − 67.5 = 97.5 m; hub height derived as tip height minus rotor radius

Arkona.dz: 水深 23–37 公尺（Siemens Gamesa 新聞稿、德文維基百科）；SWT-6.0-154 葉輪直徑 154 公尺；輪轂高度查無出處；heise 新聞（2019 年啟用）：60 座風機輪轂高度「略高於 100 m」，葉輪直徑 154 m。
Arkona.de: Water depth 23–37 m (Siemens Gamesa press release, German Wikipedia); SWT-6.0-154 rotor diameter 154 m; no hub-height source; heise news (2019 inauguration): the 60 turbines have a hub height of 'just over 100 m' and a 154 m rotor.

Arcadis Ost 1.dz: 水深最深 45 公尺（Parkwind）；V174-9.5 MW 輪轂高度 107 公尺（海平面起算，德文維基百科引核准文件）、葉輪直徑 174 公尺；Power Technology 寫輪轂 110 公尺。
Arcadis Ost 1.de: Water depth up to 45 m (Parkwind); V174-9.5 MW hub height 107 m above sea level (German Wikipedia citing the permit) and rotor 174 m; Power Technology gives 110 m.

Baltic Eagle.dz: 水深 40–45 公尺、V174-9.5MW 輪轂高度 107 公尺、葉輪直徑 174 公尺（Power Technology）。
Baltic Eagle.de: Water depth 40–45 m, V174-9.5MW hub height 107 m and rotor diameter 174 m (Power Technology).

Ems Emden (Enercon E-112 nearshore).zh: 堤腳外約 40 m 的河口水域中，在鋼板樁圍堰內澆築、由 40 支鋼管樁支撐的混凝土基座；聯邦能源登錄（MaStR）把它列為陸域風機
Ems Emden (Enercon E-112 nearshore).en: In the estuary about 40 m off the dike toe: a concrete base on 40 steel tube piles, cast inside a sheet-pile wall; the federal energy register (MaStR) lists it as an onshore turbine
Ems Emden (Enercon E-112 nearshore).dz: 水深約 2–3 公尺、葉輪直徑 114 公尺（Wikimedia Commons 說明），輪轂高度 108 公尺（windmesse.de，2004 年 EWE 新聞）。
Ems Emden (Enercon E-112 nearshore).de: Water depth about 2–3 m and rotor diameter 114 m (Wikimedia Commons description); hub height 108 m (windmesse.de, 2004 EWE news).

Breitling (Rostock).zh: 水深約 2 m 處以鋼板樁圍成、用砂與混凝土築成的基座（直徑 18 m）；聯邦能源登錄（MaStR）把它列為陸域風機
Breitling (Rostock).en: A sheet-pile ring in about 2 m of water, built up with sand and concrete (18 m across); the federal energy register (MaStR) lists it as an onshore turbine
Breitling (Rostock).dz: 水深約 2 公尺、Nordex N90/2500 葉輪直徑 90 公尺（windmesse.de，2006 年）；輪轂高度查無可靠出處（總高 125 公尺）；Nordex N90/2500；windmesse 報導整機高 125 m、葉輪直徑 90 m，輪轂高 ≈ 125 − 45 = 80 m（推算）；輪轂高度由總高或葉尖高減葉輪半徑推算
Breitling (Rostock).de: Water depth about 2 m and Nordex N90/2500 rotor diameter 90 m (windmesse.de, 2006); no reliable hub-height source (total height 125 m); Nordex N90/2500; windmesse gives a 125 m overall height and a 90 m rotor, so hub ≈ 125 − 45 = 80 m (derived); hub height derived from overall or tip height minus rotor radius

Windpark Fryslân.dz: NS Energy／Power Technology：水深 3–6 m，89 × SWT-DD-130 輪轂 109 m、葉輪 130 m。
Windpark Fryslân.de: NS Energy / Power Technology: 3–6 m depth, 89 × SWT-DD-130 with 109 m hub and 130 m rotor.

Westermeerwind.dz: WindPowerNL：水深 4–7 m，48 × Siemens SWT-3.0-DD 輪轂 95 m、葉尖 149 m、葉輪 108 m（英文維基寫 3–7 m）。
Westermeerwind.de: WindPowerNL: 4–7 m depth, 48 × Siemens SWT-3.0-DD with 95 m hub, 149 m tip and 108 m rotor (English Wikipedia says 3–7 m).

Windplanblauw offshore wind farm.zh: 湖中 24 部風機：每座以 22 支鋼管樁（間以板樁）圍成一圈、填砂，上面是直徑約 20 m 的混凝土基座
Windplanblauw offshore wind farm.en: The 24 turbines in the lake: each stands on a ring of 22 steel tube piles (with sheet piles between them), filled with sand and topped by a concrete base about 20 m across
Windplanblauw offshore wind farm.dz: WindPowerNL：IJsselmeer 平均水深 4.5 m；近岸 24 × GE Cypress 5.5 MW 輪轂 125.7 m、葉輪 158 m、葉尖 202 m。
Windplanblauw offshore wind farm.de: WindPowerNL: IJsselmeer averages 4.5 m deep; the 24 nearshore GE Cypress 5.5 MW turbines have 125.7 m hub, 158 m rotor and 202 m tip height.

Irene Vorrink (Dronten).zh: 28 座鋼製單樁，立在堤外的水中（2022 年拆除）
Irene Vorrink (Dronten).en: 28 steel monopiles in the water off the dike (dismantled in 2022)
Irene Vorrink (Dronten).dz: CA-OWEE 離岸風場資料庫（標示「運轉中」）：Irene Vorrink 28 部 NordTank、離岸 20 m、水深 5 m。輪轂高度查不到：荷蘭文維基百科只說風機「將近 50 m 高」，沒寫是輪轂高還是總高，不採用。
Irene Vorrink (Dronten).de: CA-OWEE offshore wind database (status 'Operational'): Irene Vorrink's 28 NordTank turbines, 20 m from shore, 5 m water depth. Hub height not found: Dutch Wikipedia only says the turbines are 'almost 50 m high', without saying hub or total height, so it is not used.

Borssele V (Two Towers innovation site).zh: 2 座單樁；其中一座試用 Slip Joint（單樁與轉接段以錐面套接）
Borssele V (Two Towers innovation site).en: 2 monopiles; one tests a Slip Joint (a conical connection between the monopile and transition piece)
Borssele V (Two Towers innovation site).dz: WindPowerNL：水深 15–37 m，2 × MHI Vestas V164-9.5 MW；輪轂高度未查到。
Borssele V (Two Towers innovation site).de: WindPowerNL: 15–37 m depth, 2 × MHI Vestas V164-9.5 MW; hub height not found.

Kriegers Flak.dz: 英文維基：最大水深 25 m、輪轂 107 m、葉輪 167 m（SG 8.4-167 DD）；Vattenfall：總高 188 m。
Kriegers Flak.de: English Wikipedia: max water depth 25 m, hub 107 m, rotor 167 m (SG 8.4-167 DD); Vattenfall: total height 188 m.

Rødsand II.zh: 混凝土沉箱重力式基礎（與 Nysted 相同）
Rødsand II.dz: Aarsleff：基礎底面高程 −7.5 至 −12.5 m；Power Technology：輪轂 68.5 m、葉輪 93 m（SWT-2.3-93）。
Rødsand II.de: Aarsleff: foundation levels −7.5 to −12.5 m; Power Technology: hub height 68.5 m, rotor 93 m (SWT-2.3-93).

Nysted (Rødsand I).zh: 壓艙的混凝土沉箱；2022 年一部風機倒塌拆除、一部停用，其餘 70 部繼續運轉
Nysted (Rødsand I).en: Ballasted concrete caissons; one turbine collapsed and was removed in 2022 and another was taken out of service, leaving 70 in operation
Nysted (Rødsand I).dz: Aarsleff：基礎坐落水深 7.5–12.5 m；CERC 驗證報告：Bonus 2.3 MW 輪轂 69 m、直徑 82.4 m。
Nysted (Rødsand I).de: Aarsleff: foundations placed at 7.5–12.5 m depth; CERC validation report: Bonus 2.3 MW hub height 69 m, diameter 82.4 m.

Middelgrunden.dz: 丹麥文維基：水深 4–8 m；能源署文件：Bonus76 輪轂 64 m、塔高 60 m、葉輪 76 m。
Middelgrunden.de: Danish Wikipedia: water depth 4–8 m; Danish Energy Agency document: Bonus76 hub height 64 m, tower 60 m, rotor 76 m.

Samsø.zh: 10 座單樁，配混凝土轉接段
Samsø.dz: 能源署文件：Bonus 2.3MW 葉輪 82.4 m、輪轂 61.2 m（2017 年更換的第 7 號機為 SWP 2.3-93，輪轂 66.5 m）；水深查無可引用出處（維基清單 10–13 m 未能核對）；水深取自英文維基百科的國家離岸風場清單
Samsø.de: Danish Energy Agency document: Bonus 2.3MW rotor 82.4 m, hub 61.2 m (replacement turbine 7 from 2017 is an SWP 2.3-93 with 66.5 m hub); no quotable source for water depth (Wikipedia list 10–13 m not verified); water depth from the English Wikipedia country list

Sprogø.zh: 混凝土重力式基礎（每座最重約 1,900 噸）
Sprogø.en: Concrete gravity bases (up to about 1,900 t each)
Sprogø.dz: A1 Consult 專案頁：7 座混凝土基礎於 6–17 m 水深、Vestas V90-3.0 輪轂 70 m。
Sprogø.de: A1 Consult project page: seven concrete foundations in 6–17 m water depth, Vestas V90-3.0 with 70 m hub height.

Avedøre Holme.zh: 3 座混凝土重力式基座，立在堤外約 2 m 深的水中（依 2008 年環評的設計）
Avedøre Holme.en: 3 concrete gravity bases in about 2 m of water off the dike (as designed in the 2008 EIA)
Avedøre Holme.dz: 英文維基：最大水深 2 m（近岸）、輪轂 93 m、葉輪 120 m（Siemens SWT-3.6-120）。
Avedøre Holme.de: English Wikipedia: max water depth 2 m (nearshore), hub 93 m, rotor 120 m (Siemens SWT-3.6-120).

Tunø Knob.dz: 英文維基：水深 3–6 m（infobox 最大 7 m）、風機高 45 m（未註明是輪轂高，暫記為塔高）、葉輪 39 m（Vestas V39-500）。
Tunø Knob.de: English Wikipedia: 3–6 m water (infobox max 7 m), turbines 45 metres high (not stated as hub height, recorded as tower height), rotor 39 m (Vestas V39-500).

Lillgrund.zh: 鋼筋混凝土重力式基礎，內填壓艙物
Lillgrund.en: Reinforced-concrete gravity bases filled with ballast
Lillgrund.dz: Vattenfall 技術報告（OSTI）寫水深 4–8 m；英文維基 infobox 寫 SWT-2.3-93 輪轂 65 m、葉輪 93 m（德文維基寫水深 4–13 m）。
Lillgrund.de: Vattenfall technical report (OSTI): 4–8 m water depth; English Wikipedia infobox: SWT-2.3-93 with 65 m hub and 93 m rotor (German Wikipedia says 4–13 m).

Kårehamn.dz: Herbosch-Kiere／offshoreWIND.biz 寫水深 8–21 m；Aneo 寫 16 × Vestas V112 輪轂約 80 m。
Kårehamn.de: Herbosch-Kiere / offshoreWIND.biz: 8–21 m depth; Aneo: 16 × Vestas V112 with about 80 m hub height.

Vindpark Vänern (Gässlingegrund).zh: 錨定在湖底岩盤上的基礎（維納恩湖）
Vindpark Vänern (Gässlingegrund).en: Anchored to the bedrock of the lake bed (Lake Vänern)
Vindpark Vänern (Gässlingegrund).dz: 瑞典文維基寫水深 3–13 m；evwind（WinWinD 新聞）寫 10 × WWD-3 葉輪 100 m、輪轂 88 m。
Vindpark Vänern (Gässlingegrund).de: Swedish Wikipedia: 3–13 m depth; evwind (WinWinD release): ten WWD-3 turbines with 100 m rotor and 88 m hub height.

Utgrunden I.dz: 瑞典環保署 Vindval 報告 5963（2009）：Utgrunden 7 部風機輪轂高 65 m、葉輪直徑 70.5 m，水深 6～10 m；Modern Power Systems 專文（NS Energy 轉載）：單樁打設處水深 7.1～9.9 m（取此較精確的範圍）。
Utgrunden I.de: Swedish EPA Vindval report 5963 (2009): Utgrunden's seven turbines have a 65 m hub height and 70.5 m rotor, water depth 6–10 m; Modern Power Systems feature (reprinted by NS Energy): monopiles driven at water depths of 7.1–9.9 m (the more precise range is used).

Bockstigen.zh: 鑽孔植入石灰岩的單樁
Bockstigen.en: Monopiles set in holes drilled into the limestone
Bockstigen.dz: Windpower Monthly：2018 年以 V47 機艙與葉片翻新，葉輪由 38 m 增為 47 m（原 Wind World 550 kW），塔架與基礎未更動；Risø IEA Annex XVII 風況資料庫寫原機輪轂高度 41.5 m，故輪轂高度不變；水深取自英文維基百科的國家離岸風場清單
Bockstigen.de: Windpower Monthly: repowered in 2018 with used V47 nacelles and blades, rotor up from 38 m to 47 m (originally Wind World 550 kW), towers and foundations untouched; the Risø IEA Annex XVII wind database gives the original 41.5 m hub height, so it is unchanged; water depth from the English Wikipedia country list

Pori Tahkoluoto (Offshore Pori).zh: 填石的鋼製重力式基礎（海床是岩盤，無法打單樁；需抵抗海冰）
Pori Tahkoluoto (Offshore Pori).en: Rock-filled steel gravity bases (the bedrock rules out monopiles; built for ice loads)
Pori Tahkoluoto (Offshore Pori).dz: WindEurope 寫水深 9 m；Hyötytuuli 寫 10 × 4 MW Siemens 機組輪轂約 90 m、葉輪 130 m（SWT-4.0-130），官網另列 2.3 MW 示範機 80 m／101 m。
Pori Tahkoluoto (Offshore Pori).de: WindEurope gives 9 m water depth; Hyötytuuli says the ten 4 MW Siemens turbines (SWT-4.0-130) have about 90 m hub height and 130 m rotor; the 2.3 MW demo unit is 80 m / 101 m.

Belwind Alstom Haliade demonstrator.zh: 61 m 高的套管，架在預先打入海床的樁上（2013 年）；OSPAR 把它併在 Belwind 一期（單樁）裡
Belwind Alstom Haliade demonstrator.en: A 61 m jacket set on pre-driven piles (2013); OSPAR merges it into Belwind phase 1 (monopiles)
Belwind Alstom Haliade demonstrator.dz: FoundOcean 案例：水深 34 m、機艙高 100 m、葉輪 150 m（Alstom Haliade 150-6MW）；Tethys 寫輪轂 100 m。
Belwind Alstom Haliade demonstrator.de: FoundOcean case study: water depth 34 m, height 100 m, rotor 150 m (Alstom Haliade 150-6MW); Tethys lists hub height 100 m.

Seagreen Phase 1.zh: 114 座吸力桶套管；OSPAR 這筆沒有寫型式
Seagreen Phase 1.en: 114 suction-bucket jackets; OSPAR’s record gives no type
Seagreen Phase 1.dz: 英文維基百科：導管架安裝於 42–58 m 水深，SSE Renewables 新聞稿：最深基礎 58.6 m；Scottish Enterprise：輪轂高度 120 m；114 座 MHI Vestas V164-10 MW，葉輪 164 m。
Seagreen Phase 1.de: en.wikipedia: jackets installed in 42–58 m of water, SSE Renewables release: deepest foundation at 58.6 m; Scottish Enterprise: hub height 120 m; 114 MHI Vestas V164-10 MW, 164 m rotor.

Moray West.zh: 全部為單樁（2024 年 4 月裝完）；OSPAR 列為套管，與建成紀錄不符
Moray West.en: All monopiles (completed April 2024); OSPAR lists jackets, which does not match what was built
Moray West.dz: NS Energy：場址水深 35–54 m；英文維基百科：風機立於 120 m 高塔筒上（塔高，非輪轂高度）；60 座 Siemens Gamesa SG 14-222 DD，葉輪 222 m。
Moray West.de: NS Energy: site water depth 35–54 m; en.wikipedia: turbines mounted on 120 m tall towers (tower height, not hub height); 60 Siemens Gamesa SG 14-222 DD, 222 m rotor.

Neart na Gaoithe.dz: NnG 2018 專案手冊：水深 45–55 m；NS Energy：54 座 Siemens Gamesa SG 8.0-167 DD（葉輪 167 m）；施工前核定的開發規格與配置計畫（DSLP Rev 4.0，已選定機型）：輪轂高 119–125 m（LAT 起算）、風機所在水深 45–54 m。
Neart na Gaoithe.de: NnG 2018 project brochure: water depth 45–55 m; NS Energy: 54 Siemens Gamesa SG 8.0-167 DD (167 m rotor); the pre-construction Development Specification and Layout Plan (DSLP Rev 4.0, after turbine selection): hub 119–125 m above LAT, turbines in 45–54 m of water.

Dogger Bank A.dz: Dogger Bank 官網（B 期單樁新聞）：Dogger Bank 單樁設計安裝水深最深 32 m（整個開發區 18–63 m，最小值未分期列出）；GE 新聞稿：Haliade-X 13 MW 葉輪 220 m；輪轂高度未查到。
Dogger Bank A.de: doggerbank.com (Dogger Bank B monopile news): monopiles designed for installation in water depths of up to 32 m (whole zone 18–63 m; no per-phase minimum given); GE release: Haliade-X 13 MW has a 220 m rotor; hub height not found.

Sofia.zh: 100 座加長單樁（不另加轉接段）

Îles d'Yeu et de Noirmoutier.dz: Power Technology／NS Energy 寫水深 19–36 m、61 × SG 8.0-167；輪轂高度未查到；AFP（Connaissance des Énergies，2025 年施工中）：組裝後風機高 202 m、葉輪直徑 167 m，輪轂高 ≈ 202 − 83.5 = 118.5 m（環評寫 118.4 m，最低天文潮起算）；輪轂高度由葉尖高減葉輪半徑推算
Îles d'Yeu et de Noirmoutier.de: Power Technology / NS Energy: 19–36 m depth, 61 × SG 8.0-167; hub height not found; AFP via Connaissance des Énergies (2025, during construction): assembled turbines 202 m tall with a 167 m rotor; hub ≈ 202 − 83.5 = 118.5 m (EIA: 118.4 m above LAT); hub height derived as tip height minus rotor radius

Arklow Bank Phase 1.dz: GE Wind Energy 為本風場出的專案說明（2003 年施工期間，Rhode Island 卷宗收錄）：7 部 GE 3.6s，輪轂高 73.5 m、葉尖 124 m、塔高 70.5 m；GE 2004 年「即將完工」新聞稿：3.6 MW 風機採 104 m 葉輪；英文維基百科資訊框同為輪轂 73.5 m、葉輪 104 m。說明書寫於施工期間（不是竣工文件）。水深查不到這一期的出處（CA-OWEE 的 2～5 m 是整個 520 MW 租約範圍）。
Arklow Bank Phase 1.de: GE Wind Energy's project fact sheet for this farm (2003, during construction; filed in a Rhode Island docket): 7 GE 3.6s, hub height 73.5 m, 124 m to blade tip, tower 70.5 m; GE's 2004 'nearing completion' release: the 3.6 MW turbines use a 104 m rotor; the English Wikipedia infobox also gives a 73.5 m hub and 104 m rotor. The fact sheet dates from construction (not a completion document). No phase-specific depth source (CA-OWEE's 2–5 m covers the whole 520 MW lease).

Beleolico (Taranto).zh: 10 座單樁；地中海第一座離岸風場
Beleolico (Taranto).en: 10 monopiles; the first offshore wind farm in the Mediterranean
Beleolico (Taranto).dz: offshoreWIND.biz 寫水深 4–18 m（另一篇寫 3–18 m）、10 × MySE 3.0-135；輪轂高度未查到；La Nuova Ecologia：塔頂輪轂位於海平面上 89 m，葉輪直徑 135 m。
Beleolico (Taranto).de: offshoreWIND.biz: 4–18 m water depth (another article says 3–18 m), 10 × MySE 3.0-135; hub height not found; La Nuova Ecologia: the hub sits 89 m above sea level; rotor diameter 135 m.

Elican / Elisa (Gran Canaria).zh: 重力式基礎配伸縮式塔架，可自行安裝的原型機
Elican / Elisa (Gran Canaria).en: A gravity-based foundation with a telescopic tower; a self-installing prototype
Elican / Elisa (Gran Canaria).dz: ETIPWind 簡報：Elisa 原型（5 MW SGRE 機組）設於 30 m 水深；輪轂高度與葉輪直徑查無可引用出處（機型 SG 5.0-132 未在可抓取頁面出現）；Canarias7 報導：葉輪直徑 132 m，輪轂高於最低天文潮 82.77 m（SG 5.0-132）。
Elican / Elisa (Gran Canaria).de: ETIPWind presentation: the Elisa prototype (5 MW SGRE turbine) is installed at 30 m depth; no quotable source for hub height or rotor diameter (SG 5.0-132 not named on fetchable pages); Canarias7: rotor 132 m, hub 82.77 m above lowest astronomical tide (SG 5.0-132).

Hywind Scotland.dz: Equinor 專案頁：水深 95–120 m，葉輪直徑 154 m；輪轂高度 101 m（英文維基百科資訊框）。
Hywind Scotland.de: Equinor project page: water depth 95–120 m, rotor 154 m; hub height 101 m (en.wikipedia infobox).

Kincardine.zh: Principle Power 的 WindFloat 半潛式平台
Kincardine.dz: Principle Power 專案頁：水深 60–80 m，5 座 Vestas V164 9.5 MW（葉輪 164 m，英文維基百科）；輪轂高度未查到（來源只給葉尖 190 m）；Tethys（PNNL）專案頁：V164-9.525，輪轂高 105 m。
Kincardine.de: Principle Power project page: 60–80 m water depth, five Vestas V164 9.5 MW (164 m rotor, en.wikipedia); hub height not found (sources give only 190 m tip height); Tethys (PNNL) project page: V164-9.525, hub height 105 m.

WindFloat Atlantic.zh: Principle Power 的 WindFloat 半潛式平台
WindFloat Atlantic.dz: Principle Power／Power Technology：水深 100 m，3 × V164-8.4 MW 葉輪 164 m；輪轂高度未查到（只有 185–190 m 葉尖高）；Power Technology：葉輪直徑 164 m、含基礎的葉尖高 190 m；葉尖高 − 葉輪半徑 = 108 m；輪轂高度由葉尖高減葉輪半徑推算
WindFloat Atlantic.de: Principle Power / Power Technology: 100 m water depth, 3 × V164-8.4 MW with 164 m rotor; hub height not found (only 185–190 m tip height); Power Technology: 164 m rotor and 190 m tip height including base; tip height minus rotor radius = 108 m; hub height derived as tip height minus rotor radius

WindFloat 1 (Aguçadoura demo).zh: 第一部裝在半潛式平台上的浮動式風機（2011–2016 年；之後移到蘇格蘭 Kincardine 再運轉到 2020 年）
WindFloat 1 (Aguçadoura demo).en: The first floating turbine on a semi-submersible (2011–2016; later moved to Kincardine in Scotland, where it ran until 2020)
WindFloat 1 (Aguçadoura demo).dz: Principle Power 專案頁：2011 年裝在葡萄牙 Póvoa do Varzim 外海的 2 MW Vestas V80 浮式示範機，離岸 5 km、水深 45 m。輪轂高度查不到。
WindFloat 1 (Aguçadoura demo).de: Principle Power project page: the 2 MW Vestas V80 floating demonstrator off Póvoa do Varzim, Portugal (2011), 5 km from shore in 45 m of water. Hub height not found.

Floatgen (SEM-REV).zh: BW Ideol 的阻尼池式駁船
Floatgen (SEM-REV).dz: BW Ideol 寫水深 33 m、Vestas V80 2 MW；Open-C 基金會寫葉輪 80 m、塔高 60 m。
Floatgen (SEM-REV).de: BW Ideol: 33 m water depth, Vestas V80 2 MW; Open-C foundation: 80 m rotor, 60 m mast height.

EolMed (Gruissan).zh: BW Ideol 的阻尼池式駁船（鋼造）
EolMed (Gruissan).dz: offshoreWIND.biz（2026-04 併網）：水深約 60 m、3 部 Vestas V164-10.0 MW；Vestas 新聞稿：V164-10.0 MW 葉輪 164 m。輪轂高度未查到（新聞稿的約 105 m 是機型的一般值，不是本場建成值）。
EolMed (Gruissan).de: offshoreWIND.biz (energised Apr 2026): about 60 m of water, three Vestas V164-10.0 MW; Vestas release: the V164-10.0 MW has a 164 m rotor. Hub height not found (the release’s approximate 105 m is a generic figure for the model, not this farm’s as-built value).

Les Éoliennes Flottantes du Golfe du Lio.zh: Principle Power 的 WindFloat 半潛式平台
Les Éoliennes Flottantes du Golfe du Lio.dz: Connaissance des Énergies（2026 年併網報導）：EFGL 水深 70 m；NS Energy：3 部 V164-10.0 MW，葉輪 164 m。輪轂高度未查到（報導只寫葉尖高 186 m 與葉片長 80 m，葉片長不是葉輪半徑，不能相減）。
Les Éoliennes Flottantes du Golfe du Lio.de: Connaissance des Énergies (2026 grid-connection report): 70 m water depth at EFGL; NS Energy: three V164-10.0 MW with a 164 m rotor. Hub height not found (reports give only a 186 m tip height and 80 m blades; blade length is not the rotor radius, so no subtraction).

DemoSATH (BiMEP).zh: Saitec 的 SATH 混凝土駁船
DemoSATH (BiMEP).dz: BiMEP 試驗場水深約 85 m（Saitec／Tethys），1 × 2 MW 機組輪轂高 70 m、葉輪 82 m（Tethys）。
DemoSATH (BiMEP).de: BiMEP test site about 85 m deep (Saitec / Tethys); the single 2 MW turbine has 70 m hub height and 82 m rotor (Tethys).

Mingyang OceanX (Tiancheng) floating.zh: 一座浮台上兩部 8.3 MW 風機，浮台由浮筒與混凝土構件組成（日本國土交通省的調查列為半潛式）
Mingyang OceanX (Tiancheng) floating.en: Two 8.3 MW turbines on one floater of buoys and concrete members (listed as a semi-submersible in a survey by Japan’s MLIT)
Mingyang OceanX (Tiancheng) floating.dz: 日本國交省報告：水深35 m 以上（無上限，故留空）、葉輪直徑182 m；CPEM 稱機型 MySE8.3-180（180 m），數字不一致；輪轂高度未查得；水深約45米（陽江市政府）；輪轂中心高度128米（國家稅務總局廣東省稅務局轉載南方日報）
Mingyang OceanX (Tiancheng) floating.de: MLIT (Japan) report: water depth over 35 m (no upper bound, left blank), rotor diameter 182 m; CPEM names the turbine MySE8.3-180 (180 m), figures disagree; hub height not found; Water depth about 45 m (Yangjiang government); hub centre height 128 m (Nanfang Daily via Guangdong tax bureau)

Haiyou Guanlan (CNOOC floating).zh: 半潛式；供電給文昌油田群，不接公用電網
Haiyou Guanlan (CNOOC floating).en: Semi-submersible; it supplies the Wenchang oilfield grid, not the public grid
Haiyou Guanlan (CNOOC floating).dz: 水深120 m（中國政府網）；葉輪158 m（CPEM 轉中國海油）；浮體上方塔柱約83 m，非海平面起算的輪轂高度，故留空。
Haiyou Guanlan (CNOOC floating).de: Water depth 120 m (gov.cn); rotor 158 m (CPEM citing CNOOC); the tower column above the floater is about 83 m, not a hub height above sea level, so left blank.

Haiyou Anlan (CNOOC floating).zh: 張力腿式平台（新華社：「首座16兆瓦張力腿深遠海浮式風電平台」）；供電給陸豐油田，不接公用電網
Haiyou Anlan (CNOOC floating).en: Tension-leg platform (Xinhua: “the first 16 MW tension-leg deep-sea floating wind platform”); it supplies the Lufeng oilfield, not the public grid
Haiyou Anlan (CNOOC floating).dz: 科技日報（2026-08 併網）：「從水面到風機中心高度約 150 米」、安裝在水深 136 m 的陸豐油田；IT之家：葉輪直徑 260 m。輪轂高度是約略值。
Haiyou Anlan (CNOOC floating).de: Science and Technology Daily (grid connection, Aug 2026): "about 150 m from the water surface to the turbine centre", installed at the Lufeng oilfield in 136 m of water; ITHome: 260 m rotor. The hub height is approximate.

Yangjiang Shapa 'Sanxia Yinling' floatin.dz: 機位水深約30 m（國資委），場址28–32 m（平安證券／格隆匯）；輪轂中心距海平面約107 m、葉輪158 m（CPEM 轉載三峽資料）。
Yangjiang Shapa 'Sanxia Yinling' floatin.de: Turbine position water depth about 30 m (SASAC), site 28-32 m (Ping An Securities via Gelonghui); hub centre about 107 m above sea level, rotor 158 m (CPEM citing CTG).

Hibiki floating demo (NEDO).zh: 鋼製駁船式浮台，搭載兩葉片 3 MW 風機
Hibiki floating demo (NEDO).en: A steel barge floater carrying a two-bladed 3 MW turbine
Hibiki floating demo (NEDO).dz: NEDO 新聞稿：北九州市沖約 15 km、水深約 50 m；葉輪 100 m、輪轂 72 m。
Hibiki floating demo (NEDO).de: NEDO press release: about 15 km off Kitakyushu in about 50 m of water; rotor 100 m, hub 72 m.

Goto Sakiyama floating demonstration.zh: 戶田建設的混合式單柱浮台「はえんかぜ」
Goto Sakiyama floating demonstration.dz: 戶田建設「はえんかぜ」：輪轂 56 m、葉輪 80 m；自然能源財團專欄稱島嶼近海水深約 100 m 前後（概略值）。
Goto Sakiyama floating demonstration.de: Toda 'Haenkaze': hub 56 m, rotor 80 m; Renewable Energy Institute column gives roughly 100 m water depth near the island (approximate).

Goto City Offshore floating project.zh: 8 座混合式單柱浮台（上段鋼、下段混凝土）
Goto City Offshore floating project.en: 8 hybrid spars (steel upper part, concrete lower part)
Goto City Offshore floating project.dz: 關西電力 2026-01-05 商轉新聞稿：2.1 MW × 8 部，葉輪直徑 80 m；水深與輪轂高度未查到（新聞稿的「全長 176.1 m」含水下浮體，不是高度）。
Goto City Offshore floating project.de: Kansai Electric commercial-operation release (5 Jan 2026): 8 × 2.1 MW with an 80 m rotor; water depth and hub height not found (the release’s 176.1 m overall length includes the submerged spar and is not a height).

Fukushima FORWARD floating demo.zh: 兩部半潛式（2 MW、7 MW V 型）與一部單柱式（5 MW），型式不同，所以不標單一細分型式
Fukushima FORWARD floating demo.en: Two semi-submersibles (2 MW and a V-shaped 7 MW) and one spar (5 MW); the types differ, so no single sub-type is given

Donghai Bridge.zh: 34 部 3 MW 風機立在高樁混凝土承台上（上海市政府：2010 年 6 月 8 日全部風機併網），中國第一座大型離岸風場
Donghai Bridge.en: 34 × 3 MW turbines on high-rise pile caps with concrete caps (Shanghai government: all turbines connected on 8 June 2010); China’s first large offshore wind farm
Donghai Bridge.dz: 上海市政府：平均水深10 m，塔筒高90 m（塔高）；英文維基百科：葉輪直徑90 m（Sinovel SL3000/90），輪轂高度91 m。
Donghai Bridge.de: Shanghai municipal government: average water depth 10 m, tower 90 m (tower height); English Wikipedia: rotor diameter 90 m (Sinovel SL3000/90), hub height 91 m.

CTG Rudong H6.zh: 100 部 4 MW 風機，全部為單樁（2021 年 12 月全容量併網；與 H10 共用柔性直流送出）
CTG Rudong H6.en: 100 × 4 MW turbines, all on monopiles (fully connected in December 2021; shares a flexible HVDC link with H10)
CTG Rudong H6.dz: NS Energy：如東H6、H10 共用描述，葉輪直徑146米，水深9–20米（兩場合計範圍）；Power Technology：H6 為100台 SWT-4.0-146；輪轂高度查無。
CTG Rudong H6.de: NS Energy (H6 and H10 together): rotor 146 m, water depth 9-20 m (combined range); Power Technology: H6 has 100 x SWT-4.0-146; hub not found.

CTG Rudong H10.zh: 100 部 4 MW 風機：77 座單樁、23 座複合筒（2021 年 12 月全容量併網）
CTG Rudong H10.en: 100 × 4 MW turbines: 77 on monopiles and 23 on composite buckets (fully connected in December 2021)
CTG Rudong H10.dz: 世紀新能源網（招標公告）：H10場區水深14–22 m，100台4.0 MW；機型與輪轂未找到；Power Technology：100台 SWT-4.0-146，葉輪146米；輪轂高度查無。
CTG Rudong H10.de: ne21 (tender notice): H10 site depth 14–22 m, 100 x 4.0 MW; model and hub not found; Power Technology: 100 x SWT-4.0-146, rotor 146 m; hub not found.

CTG Zhangpu Liu'ao Phase 2.zh: 四樁套管（福建省工信廳：機位水深逾 46 m，設計團隊採「4 樁導管架」）；28 部 13 MW 以上機組（含 6 部 16 MW），2024 年 6 月全容量併網（澎湃新聞）
CTG Zhangpu Liu'ao Phase 2.en: Four-pile jackets (Fujian industry department: over 46 m of water, the design team chose a four-pile jacket); 28 turbines of 13 MW and above (six of 16 MW), fully connected in June 2024 (The Paper)
CTG Zhangpu Liu'ao Phase 2.dz: 水深26–42 m（東南網）；13 MW 機組輪轂中心148 m（國際風能網），16 MW 機組152 m（福建省政府）；葉輪直徑未查得；16兆瓦機組葉輪直徑252米（中國中鐵）
CTG Zhangpu Liu'ao Phase 2.de: Water depth 26-42 m (fjsen); hub centre 148 m for the 13 MW units (ewindpower) and 152 m for the 16 MW units (Fujian government); rotor diameter not found; 16 MW turbines with a 252 m rotor (China Railway Group)

Datang Nan'ao Lemen I.zh: 35 部上海電氣 7 MW 全部為無過渡段單樁：變更海域使用補充論證報告書（汕頭市政府公開，依「實際建設方案」論證；2021-03-16 海上開工、2021-12-29 全容量併網）寫「均採用無過渡段單樁基礎方案」，並引竣工環境保護驗收調查報告：「本工程海上風機採用單樁基礎」。
Datang Nan'ao Lemen I.en: All 35 Shanghai Electric 7 MW turbines stand on monopiles without transition pieces: the supplementary sea-use change report (Shantou government, argued on the as-built scheme; offshore works from 16 Mar 2021, full grid connection 29 Dec 2021) says all use transition-piece-free monopiles and cites the completion environmental acceptance report: "the offshore turbines of this project use monopile foundations".
Datang Nan'ao Lemen I.dz: 大唐南澳勒門Ⅰ變更海域使用補充論證報告書（汕頭市政府公開，2026 年，「本次論證根據實際建設方案」）：35 台上海電氣 7 MW，風機直徑 154 m、輪轂高度 105 m（原核准方案寫 100 m）；場址水深 18–27 m。
Datang Nan'ao Lemen I.de: Datang Nan'ao Lemen I supplementary sea-use report (Shantou government, 2026, "based on the actual construction scheme"): 35 Shanghai Electric 7 MW turbines, rotor 154 m, hub 105 m (the approved scheme said 100 m); site water depth 18–27 m.

Longyuan Rudong Intertidal 150 MW Demo.zh: 58 部：21 部西門子 2.38 MW 為多樁導管架，其餘 37 部（一期 17 部華銳 3 MW、二期 20 部金風 2.5 MW）為直徑 5.2 m 單樁。一期竣工時「17 台單樁、21 台多樁導管架」（中國駐新潟總領事館轉載，2011-12-30）；二期金風機組為單樁出自 Power Technology 與 Energy Monitor（同一出版集團）；南通海洋水建也寫全場只用單樁與多樁導管架兩種。
Longyuan Rudong Intertidal 150 MW Demo.en: 58 turbines: the 21 Siemens 2.38 MW units on multi-pile jackets and the other 37 (17 Sinovel 3 MW in phase I, 20 Goldwind 2.5 MW in phase II) on 5.2 m monopiles. Phase I’s 17 monopiles + 21 multi-pile jackets at completion (Chinese Consulate in Niigata repost, 30 Dec 2011); the phase-II Goldwind monopiles from Power Technology and Energy Monitor (same publisher); Nantong Ocean Hydraulic also says the farm used only monopiles and multi-pile jackets.
Longyuan Rudong Intertidal 150 MW Demo.dz: Power Technology（2013）：低潮時露灘、高潮時水深最多 5 m；一期 21 台西門子 2.38 MW（葉輪 101 m）＋17 台華銳 3 MW（90 m），二期 20 台金風 2.5 MW（100 m）；葉輪取最大機型 101 m，輪轂未查到。
Longyuan Rudong Intertidal 150 MW Demo.de: Power Technology (2013): dry at low tide and up to 5 m of water at high tide; phase 1 has 21 Siemens 2.38 MW (101 m rotor) and 17 Sinovel 3 MW (90 m), phase 2 20 Goldwind 2.5 MW (100 m); rotor of the largest model, 101 m; hub not found.

CGN Rudong H8.zh: 65 部風機：49 座單樁、16 座全鋼筒型（與複合筒同為以負壓沉入的單筒基礎，筒體與過渡段全為鋼製）；2021 年 12 月全容量併網
CGN Rudong H8.en: 65 turbines: 49 on monopiles and 16 on all-steel buckets (single buckets sunk by suction, like the composite bucket, but with a steel transition piece); fully connected in December 2021
CGN Rudong H8.dz: Power Technology：40台中船海裝 H171-5.0（38＋2）＋25台 SWT-4.0-146，取主要機型171米；水深、輪轂查無；如東H8招標公告：海底泥面高程 -12～-21 m（1985高程），以此作為水深範圍。
CGN Rudong H8.de: Power Technology: 40 x CSSC Haizhuang H171-5.0 (38+2) + 25 x SWT-4.0-146; main model 171 m; depth and hub not found; Rudong H8 tender notice: seabed elevation -12 to -21 m (1985 datum), used as the depth range.

CTG Dafeng H8-1 (800 MW).zh: 98 部風機全部為單樁（樁徑 7–9 m、最長 97 m、最重 1,713 t，中新網 2025 年 9 月）；2025 年 12 月 15 日全容量併網
CTG Dafeng H8-1 (800 MW).en: All 98 turbines on monopiles (7–9 m in diameter, up to 97 m long and 1,713 t; China News Service, September 2025); fully connected on 15 December 2025
CTG Dafeng H8-1 (800 MW).dz: 全案 98 台金風機組：GW191-6MW、GWH230-8.5MW（84 台，主力）、GWH252-13.6MW（1 台）；取主力機型葉輪 230 m。水深、主力機型輪轂高度未查到（13.6 MW 那台輪轂 142 m）。
CTG Dafeng H8-1 (800 MW).de: 98 Goldwind turbines: GW191-6MW, GWH230-8.5MW (84 units, main type) and one GWH252-13.6MW; rotor 230 m for the main type. Depth and main-type hub height not found (the single 13.6 MW unit has a 142 m hub).

Guangxi Fangchenggang A.zh: 83 部 8.5 MW 全部為三樁嵌岩套管：岩基海床，鋼管樁鑽孔嵌岩後灌漿，套管三腳插入樁內（國資委、新華網）；中國第一座全場採嵌岩基礎的離岸風場
Guangxi Fangchenggang A.en: All 83 × 8.5 MW turbines on three-pile rock-socketed jackets: rock seabed, the steel piles are drilled into the rock and grouted and the three jacket legs set into them (SASAC, Xinhua); China’s first offshore farm with rock-socketed foundations throughout
Guangxi Fangchenggang A.dz: A場址海深15–18 m（廣西能源集團詢價公告）；83台8.5 MW，葉輪「超230 m」、單葉片111.5 m（新浪）但無確切值；輪轂高度未查得；A場址83台8.5兆瓦機組，明陽中標機型MySE8.5-230（國資委、CPEM轉載明陽）；首台風機（8.5 MW 級）輪轂中心距海面 133.4 m（2023 年 8 月吊裝新聞）。
Guangxi Fangchenggang A.de: Site A water depth 15-18 m (Guangxi Energy Group inquiry notice); 83 x 8.5 MW, rotor 'over 230 m' and 111.5 m blades (Sina) but no exact figure; hub height not found; Site A has 83 x 8.5 MW units; Mingyang's winning model was the MySE8.5-230 (SASAC; Mingyang release via CPEM); First turbine (8.5 MW class): hub centre 133.4 m above sea level (Aug 2023 installation news).

CR Power Lianjiang Waihai.zh: 39 部 18 MW 機組：7 座單樁（直徑 10 m）、32 座套管（中國電力網 2024 年 4 月的塔筒供貨報導）
CR Power Lianjiang Waihai.en: 39 × 18 MW turbines: 7 on monopiles (10 m in diameter) and 32 on jackets (China Power, April 2024, on the tower supply)
CR Power Lianjiang Waihai.dz: 水深38–46 m（福州新聞網）；39台東方電氣18 MW 直驅機組，輪轂中心160 m、葉輪260 m（東方風電下線新聞）；國資委產品頁另載風輪258 m。
CR Power Lianjiang Waihai.de: Water depth 38-46 m (fznews); 39 x Dongfang 18 MW direct-drive units, hub centre 160 m, rotor 260 m (Dongfang Wind roll-out news); SASAC product page gives 258 m.

Shenergy Hainan CZ2 (Danzhou).zh: 67 部 9 MW 風機各立在一根單樁上（海南日報 2024 年 5 月的施工報導，單樁長 95.7 m、直徑 8.8 m、重 1,639 t）
Shenergy Hainan CZ2 (Danzhou).en: 67 × 9 MW turbines, each on a monopile (Hainan Daily construction report, May 2024: 95.7 m long, 8.8 m in diameter, 1,639 t)
Shenergy Hainan CZ2 (Danzhou).dz: 水深15–25 m，一期67台9 MW（海南日報）；輪轂高度與葉輪直徑未查得。
Shenergy Hainan CZ2 (Danzhou).de: Water depth 15-25 m, phase I 67 x 9 MW (Hainan Daily); hub height and rotor diameter not found.

CGN Shanwei Houhu.zh: 91 部 5.5 MW：82 座單樁、8 座四樁套管、1 座吸力筒套管（中新網 2021 年 11 月全數併網報導）
CGN Shanwei Houhu.en: 91 × 5.5 MW: 82 monopiles, 8 four-pile jackets and 1 suction-bucket jacket (China News Service, November 2021, on full grid connection)
CGN Shanwei Houhu.dz: 水深23–26 m（中新網）；用海調整論證報告（汕尾市政府，2021-11-24 全部 91 台併網後，「調整前後採用的風機機型不變」）：MySE5.5-155 風輪直徑 158 m（型號數字不等於直徑，同外羅一期）、輪轂中心高度 105 m（設備特性表的型號欄誤植為 MySE5.5-180）。
CGN Shanwei Houhu.de: Water depth 23–26 m (Chinanews); sea-use adjustment report (Shanwei government, after all 91 turbines were connected on 24 Nov 2021, "the turbine model is unchanged"): MySE5.5-155 with a 158 m rotor (the model number is not the diameter, as at Wailuo phase 1) and a 105 m hub centre height (the equipment table misprints the model as MySE5.5-180).

Guangdong Energy Yangjiang Qingzhou 1&2.zh: 92 部 11 MW 全部為套管（水深 35–43 m；施工標段為 92 座套管與基礎鋼管樁，中國能源新聞網另提「新型過渡段結構的深水區導管架基礎」）；2023 年 12 月 12 日全容量併網
Guangdong Energy Yangjiang Qingzhou 1&2.en: All 92 × 11 MW turbines on jackets (35–43 m of water; the construction lot covers 92 jackets and their pin piles, and China Energy News notes a deep-water jacket with a new transition piece); fully connected on 12 December 2023
Guangdong Energy Yangjiang Qingzhou 1&2.dz: 水深37–44 m，92台 MySE11-230（廣東省國資委）；葉輪230 m；澎湃新聞寫葉輪「整體吊裝至距海面160米高空，與主機精準對接」，即輪轂中心約距海面160 m（吊裝高度的說法）。
Guangdong Energy Yangjiang Qingzhou 1&2.de: Water depth 37-44 m, 92 x MySE11-230 (Guangdong SASAC); rotor 230 m; The Paper says the rotor is lifted whole to 160 m above the sea to mate with the nacelle, i.e. hub centre about 160 m above sea (stated as a lifting height).

SPIC Binhai North H2.zh: 100 部 4 MW 全部為大直徑無過渡段單樁（2017 年 5 月至 2018 年 3 月沉樁；江蘇省電機工程學會的華電重工工法介紹）
SPIC Binhai North H2.en: All 100 × 4 MW turbines on large-diameter monopiles without a transition piece (piled May 2017 to March 2018; Jiangsu Society for Electrical Engineering, on Huadian Heavy Industry’s method)
SPIC Binhai North H2.dz: CPEM（國家電投江蘇公司報導）：水深15–18 m，100台4.0 MW；能見資訊報導輪轂87.5 m、葉輪130 m（SWT-4.0-130）但該頁抓不到，故留空；新浪財經（國家電投新能源REIT招募資料）：100台西門子4.0MW，葉輪直徑130米，輪轂高度87.5米（平均海面以上）。
SPIC Binhai North H2.de: CPEM (SPIC Jiangsu report): depth 15–18 m, 100 x 4.0 MW; nengapp reports hub 87.5 m and rotor 130 m (SWT-4.0-130) but the page could not be fetched, so left null; Sina Finance (SPIC new-energy REIT): 100 x Siemens 4.0 MW, rotor 130 m, hub height 87.5 m above mean sea level.

Shandong Bozhong B2.zh: 59 部 8.5 MW 全部為單樁（2022 年 10 月首樁直徑 7.2 m、長 82 m、重 967 t；CPEM 轉載國家能源集團報導，國家能源集團 2023 年 6 月全容量併網報導寫 59 部）
Shandong Bozhong B2.en: All 59 × 8.5 MW turbines on monopiles (first pile October 2022: 7.2 m in diameter, 82 m long, 967 t; CPEM reprint of the China Energy report, whose June 2023 full-connection release gives 59 turbines)
Shandong Bozhong B2.dz: 平均水深17–19 m，59台8.5 MW，輪轂中心130 m、葉輪230 m（山東省能源局）。
Shandong Bozhong B2.de: Average water depth 17-19 m, 59 x 8.5 MW, hub centre 130 m, rotor 230 m (Shandong Energy Administration).

Huarun Cangnan 1 / CR Power.zh: 49 部（6.25 與 10 MW）全部為單樁：原設計 29 座單樁＋48 座高樁承台，改為全場單樁（華潤電力建設紀實，CPEM 轉載）；2022 年 12 月 28 日全容量併網
Huarun Cangnan 1 / CR Power.en: All 49 turbines (6.25 and 10 MW) on monopiles: the design of 29 monopiles plus 48 high-rise pile caps was changed to monopiles throughout (CR Power construction account, CPEM reprint); fully connected on 28 December 2022
Huarun Cangnan 1 / CR Power.dz: 場區水深15–24 m（海域使用論證報告書）；24台6.25 MW＋25台10 MW，葉輪直徑210 m 的抗颱大葉片機型（CPEM 轉華潤）；輪轂高度未查得。
Huarun Cangnan 1 / CR Power.de: Site water depth 15-24 m (sea-area use report); 24 x 6.25 MW + 25 x 10 MW, typhoon-class turbines with 210 m rotor (CPEM citing CR Power); hub height not found.

Jiangsu Qidong H1+H2.zh: H1、H2 共 84 部風機各一根單樁（中交一航局承建 84 根，2021 年 6 月打到第 64 根；南通發布）
Jiangsu Qidong H1+H2.en: 84 turbines across H1 and H2, one monopile each (84 piles by CCCC First Harbor, the 64th driven in June 2021; Nantong government release)
Jiangsu Qidong H1+H2.dz: 世紀新能源網（風機採購招標）：H1水深6–13 m、H2水深13–15 m，合併6–15 m；機型（6 MW級）輪轂／葉輪未找到。
Jiangsu Qidong H1+H2.de: ne21 (turbine tender): H1 depth 6–13 m, H2 depth 13–15 m, combined 6–15 m; hub/rotor of the 6 MW-class turbines not found.

CGN Fanshi I.zh: 73 部（22 部 13.6 MW＋51 部 14 MW）用四樁套管，水深 40–48 m（陽江日報的施工報導，32 號機位四根套管樁）
CGN Fanshi I.en: 73 turbines (22 × 13.6 MW and 51 × 14 MW) on four-pile jackets in 40–48 m of water (Yangjiang Daily construction report on the four jacket piles at position 32)
CGN Fanshi I.dz: 水深40–48 m，22台13.6 MW＋51台14 MW（陽江新聞網）；輪轂高度與葉輪直徑未查得。
CGN Fanshi I.de: Water depth 40-48 m, 22 x 13.6 MW + 51 x 14 MW (Yangjiang News); hub height and rotor diameter not found.

Shandong Huaneng Offshore L Area wind fa.zh: 42 部 12 MW 全部用四樁套管（最高 83.9 m），水深 52–56 m、離岸約 70 km，中國水深最深的商轉離岸風場；2026 年 4 月 7 日全容量併網（國資委、人民日報）
Shandong Huaneng Offshore L Area wind fa.en: All 42 × 12 MW turbines on four-pile jackets (up to 83.9 m tall) in 52–56 m of water about 70 km offshore, China’s deepest operating offshore farm; fully connected on 7 April 2026 (SASAC, People’s Daily)
Shandong Huaneng Offshore L Area wind fa.dz: 水深52–56 m，42台12 MW（證券時報）；用海調整論證報告（2025-12，含實際建設情況）：葉輪252 m、輪轂高度約146.34 m（環評階段的約151 m是設計值，未採用）。
Shandong Huaneng Offshore L Area wind fa.de: Water depth 52-56 m, 42 x 12 MW (STCN); sea-use adjustment report (Dec 2025, with as-built data): rotor 252 m, hub height about 146.34 m (the EIA-stage ~151 m was a design value and is not used).

SPIC Peninsula South U1.zh: 106 部 8.5 MW 全部為單樁：一期 450 MW（53 部，2023 年 11 月併網）獲 2025 年度中國電力優質工程，得獎說明寫「風機基礎單樁最大樁重 1450 噸」（網易轉載）；二期 53 部由龍源振華 2024 年 9 月全部沉樁完成（世紀新能源網；原本另列為「Shandong Haiwei Peninsula South U」的重複紀錄已於 2026-10 刪除）。
SPIC Peninsula South U1.en: All 106 × 8.5 MW on monopiles: phase 1 (450 MW, 53 units, connected Nov 2023) won a 2025 China Electric Power Quality Project award whose citation gives "turbine foundation monopiles up to 1,450 t" (via 163.com); all 53 monopiles of phase 2 were driven by Longyuan Zhenhua in Sept 2024 (ne21; the duplicate record "Shandong Haiwei Peninsula South U" for phase 2 was removed in Oct 2026).
SPIC Peninsula South U1.dz: 山東省能源局（2023-03，轉大眾日報）：半島南 U 場址位於乳山南側海域、平均水深 25–31 m。一期 53 台明陽 MySE8.5-230 的輪轂 130.9 m、葉輪 230 m（山東省能源局 2023-11）只屬一期，二期機型未查到，不填。
SPIC Peninsula South U1.de: Shandong Energy Administration (March 2023, via Dazhong Daily): the Peninsula South U site lies south of Rushan in 25–31 m of water (average). Phase 1’s 53 MingYang MySE8.5-230 have a 130.9 m hub and 230 m rotor (Shandong Energy Administration, Nov 2023), phase 1 only; phase 2’s model was not found, so they are not given.

Zhejiang Cangnan 2 Offshore wind farm.zh: 華能蒼南 2 號 36 部 8.5 MW 全部為單樁（新京報 2023 年 4 月「國內在建最大單樁風電項目」報導；最長樁 118 m、2,328 t，CPEM）
Zhejiang Cangnan 2 Offshore wind farm.en: Huaneng’s Cangnan 2: all 36 × 8.5 MW turbines on monopiles (Beijing News, April 2023, “China’s largest monopile wind project under construction”; longest pile 118 m and 2,328 t, CPEM)
Zhejiang Cangnan 2 Offshore wind farm.dz: 環評公示：場區水深約20–29 m；變更用海論證報告（2024-11）：實建36台遠景 EN-226（8.5 MW），葉輪226 m、輪轂高度136 m。
Zhejiang Cangnan 2 Offshore wind farm.de: EIA notice: site water depth about 20-29 m; sea-use change report (Nov 2024): 36 Envision EN-226 (8.5 MW) as built, rotor 226 m, hub height 136 m.

Huaneng Lingao CZ1.zh: 60 部 10 MW 全部為單樁（直徑 8.25–9.6 m、長 82–109 m、重 1,191–1,938 t；2024 年 11 月 17 日全部沉樁完成，中國電力網）
Huaneng Lingao CZ1.en: All 60 × 10 MW turbines on monopiles (8.25–9.6 m in diameter, 82–109 m long, 1,191–1,938 t; all driven by 17 November 2024, China Power)
Huaneng Lingao CZ1.dz: 場區水深11–34 m，60台10 MW（中國電力網）；輪轂高度與葉輪直徑未查得；60台明陽MySE10-242，風輪直徑242米（CPEM轉載明陽、中新網海南）；1 號 10 MW 機組：風輪直徑 242 m、輪轂高度 136.7 m（新華網 2024-04）。
Huaneng Lingao CZ1.de: Site water depth 11-34 m, 60 x 10 MW (chinapower.com.cn); hub height and rotor diameter not found; 60 x Mingyang MySE10-242, rotor 242 m (Mingyang via CPEM; China News Hainan); Unit 1 (10 MW): rotor 242 m, hub height 136.7 m (Xinhua, Apr 2024).

Zhejiang Xiangshan 1 Offshore wind farm.zh: 一期 41 部 6.2 MW：23 座高樁承台＋18 座單樁（國家能源集團）；二期 56 部 9 MW：36 座單樁＋160 根群樁（象山發布經中國線纜網），即 20 座高樁承台；兩期合計 43 座承台、54 座單樁
Zhejiang Xiangshan 1 Offshore wind farm.en: Phase 1, 41 × 6.2 MW: 23 high-rise pile caps and 18 monopiles (China Energy); phase 2, 56 × 9 MW: 36 monopiles plus 160 group piles (Xiangshan government via China Cable), i.e. 20 pile caps; 43 caps and 54 monopiles in all
Zhejiang Xiangshan 1 Offshore wind farm.dz: 輪轂與葉輪取主要機型：二期 56 台運達 WD225-9000-OS（504 MW），輪轂中心高 131 m、葉輪 225 m，原文寫已在象山1#二期併網運行（一期 41 台 6.2 MW 機型不同）；水深取泥面高程：一期北區 −9～−15 m、二期 −9～−14 m。
Zhejiang Xiangshan 1 Offshore wind farm.de: Hub and rotor are those of the main type: phase 2’s 56 Windey WD225-9000-OS (504 MW), hub centre 131 m, rotor 225 m, which the source says is running at Xiangshan 1 phase 2 (phase 1’s 41 × 6.2 MW units are a different model); depth from seabed elevations: phase 1 north area −9 to −15 m, phase 2 −9 to −14 m.

Formosa 1 Phase 1.zh: 2 座單樁，2016 年與兩部示範機組一起安裝
Formosa 1 Phase 1.en: 2 monopiles, installed in 2016 together with the two demonstration turbines
Formosa 1 Phase 1.dz: 海洋風電官網：場址水深 15～30 m；Power Technology：示範階段 2 部 Siemens SWT-4.0-120，葉輪 120 m；輪轂高度未查到；苗栗竹南海洋一期（示範）2 部 SWT-4.0-120，GlobalData 電廠資料寫塔筒高 90 公尺（Power Technology）。
Formosa 1 Phase 1.de: Formosa 1 site page: 15–30 m water depth; Power Technology: two Siemens SWT-4.0-120 with 120 m rotor; hub height not found; Formosa 1 phase IA, 2x SWT-4.0-120; GlobalData plant profile gives the tubular steel towers as 90 m high (Power Technology).

Formosa 1 Phase 2.zh: 20 座單樁，配灌漿接合的轉接段
Formosa 1 Phase 2.dz: Jan De Nul：水深 15～30 m；中文維基：第二階段 6 MW 風機輪轂 110 m；英文維基：6 MW 機型葉輪 154 m。
Formosa 1 Phase 2.de: Jan De Nul: 15–30 m water depth; Chinese Wikipedia: phase-2 6 MW turbines hub 110 m; English Wikipedia: 154 m rotor for the 6 MW units.

Taipower Offshore Phase 1 (Changhua).zh: 21 座四腳套管配轉接段，各以 4 支預打的基樁灌漿固定（共 84 支）
Taipower Offshore Phase 1 (Changhua).en: 21 four-legged jackets with transition pieces, each grouted onto four pre-installed pin piles (84 in total)
Taipower Offshore Phase 1 (Changhua).dz: 臺灣離岸風機基礎暨海事工程協會：水深 17～28 m、21×HTW5.2-127；中文維基：第一期輪轂 90 m。
Taipower Offshore Phase 1 (Changhua).de: Taiwan offshore foundation/marine association: 17–28 m water depth, 21 x HTW5.2-127; Chinese Wikipedia: phase-1 hub 90 m.

Formosa 2.zh: 47 座套管，共 188 支基樁（2022 年裝完）
Formosa 2.dz: 協會資料：水深 35～55 m、47×SG 8.0-167 DD；Jan De Nul 亦稱最深 55 m；輪轂高度未取得可引用原文；SG 8.0-167 DD 輪轂高 116.4 m；來源 power-technology。
Formosa 2.de: Association page: 35–55 m water depth, 47 x SG 8.0-167 DD; Jan De Nul also gives up to 55 m; no quotable hub-height source; SG 8.0-167 DD hub height 116.4 m; source power-technology.

Greater Changhua 1 & 2a.zh: 111 座套管，每座 3 支基樁（共 333 支）；其中 6 座全部在台灣製造
Greater Changhua 1 & 2a.en: 111 jackets, each on three pin piles (333 in total); six of them were built entirely in Taiwan
Greater Changhua 1 & 2a.dz: 沃旭案例研究：水深 23.8～44.1 m、111×SG 8.0-167 DD；輪轂高度未取得可引用原文。
Greater Changhua 1 & 2a.de: Ørsted case study: 23.8–44.1 m water depth, 111 x SG 8.0-167 DD; no quotable source for hub height.

Changfang & Xidao.zh: 62 座三腳套管（世紀風電製造），共 186 支基樁
Changfang & Xidao.en: 62 three-legged jackets (built by Century Wind Power) on 186 pin piles
Changfang & Xidao.dz: 協會資料：彰芳 57 + 西島 5 部 V174-9.5，葉輪 174 m；水深與輪轂高度未查到；水深 26–46 m；來源英國出口信貸署（UKEF）專案公告。輪轂高查不到。
Changfang & Xidao.de: Association page: 57 + 5 x V174-9.5, rotor 174 m; water depth and hub height not found; Water depth 26–46 m; source UK Export Finance project notice. Hub height not found.

Zhong Neng.zh: 31 座套管（世鎧精密製造），共 93 支國產基樁
Zhong Neng.en: 31 jackets (built by Sing Da Marine Structure) on 93 locally made pin piles
Zhong Neng.dz: 協會資料：水深 20～36 m；Vestas 2022 年訂單新聞稿與 2024 年完工新聞稿都寫 31 座 V174-9.5 MW（協會頁寫的 V164-9.5 有誤）；中能風場輪轂高度 110 公尺（中文維基百科資訊框）。
Zhong Neng.de: Association page: 20–36 m water depth; Vestas’s 2022 order release and 2024 completion release both give 31 x V174-9.5 MW (the association page’s V164-9.5 is wrong); Zhong Neng hub height 110 m (Chinese Wikipedia infobox).

Yunlin.zh: 80 座直徑 8 m 的單樁配轉接段（另有 3 座 2021–2023 年發生溜樁的單樁已移除，不計在內）
Yunlin.en: 80 monopiles 8 m across with transition pieces (three earlier ones that suffered pile runs in 2021–2023 were removed and are not counted)
Yunlin.dz: 允能官網：80×SG 8.0-167 DD，葉輪 167 m、輪轂 87 m；水深未查到；水深 7–35 m；來源 Skyborn（開發商）。
Yunlin.de: Yunlin project site: 80 x SG 8.0-167 DD, rotor 167 m, hub 87 m; water depth not found; Water depth 7–35 m; source Skyborn (developer).

Hai Long 2 & 3.zh: 73 座套管，每座 3 支預打基樁（共 219 支），2025 年 8 月裝完
Hai Long 2 & 3.en: 73 jackets, each on three pre-installed pin piles (219 in total), completed in August 2025

Greater Changhua 2b & 4.zh: 66 座全數為吸力桶套管（不打樁）：大彰化西南第二階段 24 座、西北 42 座，是亞太第一座全用吸力桶的風場
Greater Changhua 2b & 4.en: All 66 are suction-bucket jackets (no piling): 24 at Greater Changhua 2b and 42 at Greater Changhua 4, the first such farm in the Asia-Pacific

Taipower Offshore Phase 2.zh: 31 座四腳套管配轉接段，以 124 支預打基樁灌漿固定
Taipower Offshore Phase 2.en: 31 four-legged jackets with transition pieces, grouted onto 124 pre-installed pin piles

Setana semi-offshore.zh: NEDO 稱「ドルフィン」，即高樁承台：4 支直樁（長 27 m、直徑 1.1 m）上加寬約 10 m、厚 2 m 的混凝土承台
Setana semi-offshore.en: NEDO calls it a “dolphin”, that is a high-rise pile cap: four vertical piles (27 m long, 1.1 m across) under a concrete cap about 10 m wide and 2 m thick
Setana semi-offshore.dz: NEDO《著床式洋上風力發電導入手冊》的國內既設洋上風場一覽表：北海道瀨棚港「風海鳥」（2004，Vestas 0.6 MW×2）葉輪直徑 47 m、輪轂高 40 m、水深 13 m、離岸 0.7 km、支撐結構為ドルフィン（高樁承台）。
Setana semi-offshore.de: NEDO's fixed-bottom offshore wind guidebook, table of existing Japanese offshore installations: Setana Port 'Kazamidori' (2004, Vestas 0.6 MW × 2) with a 47 m rotor, 40 m hub height, 13 m water depth, 0.7 km from shore, on a 'dolphin' (high-rise pile cap).

Sakata Port semi-offshore.zh: NEDO 稱「ドルフィン」，即高樁承台：8 支直樁（長 27 m、直徑 1 m）上加直徑 12 m、厚 2.5 m 的八角形混凝土承台；2023 年撤除
Sakata Port semi-offshore.en: NEDO calls it a “dolphin”, that is a high-rise pile cap: eight vertical piles (27 m long, 1 m across) under an octagonal concrete cap 12 m across and 2.5 m thick; removed in 2023

Kamisu Phase 1 (Wind Power Ibaraki).zh: 7 座直徑 3.5 m、長 24.5 m 的單樁，配灌漿接合的套管接頭，自岸上以履帶式吊車打設
Kamisu Phase 1 (Wind Power Ibaraki).en: 7 monopiles 3.5 m across and 24.5 m long with grouted joint sleeves, driven from the shore with a crawler crane
Kamisu Phase 1 (Wind Power Ibaraki).dz: 水深 DL−3.5～−5.0 m（日本建設機械化協會施工報告）；SUBARU 80/2.0 輪轂 60 m、葉輪 80 m（鳥取縣整理資料）。
Kamisu Phase 1 (Wind Power Ibaraki).de: Water depth DL −3.5 to −5.0 m (JCMA construction report); SUBARU 80/2.0, hub 60 m, rotor 80 m (Tottori Prefecture compilation).

Kamisu Phase 2.zh: 8 座單樁；因鄰近 275 kV 輸電線，改以自升式平台船打樁
Kamisu Phase 2.en: 8 monopiles; driven from a jack-up vessel because of the 275 kV lines nearby
Kamisu Phase 2.dz: SUBARU 80/2.0（日立 HTW2.0-80），輪轂 60 m、葉輪 80 m（鳥取縣整理資料）；水深未查到。
Kamisu Phase 2.de: SUBARU 80/2.0 (Hitachi HTW2.0-80), hub 60 m, rotor 80 m (Tottori Prefecture compilation); water depth not found.

Choshi Offshore Demonstration (NEDO/TEPC.zh: 預力混凝土沉箱重力式基礎（2,400 噸），半潛拖運到場後灌入銅爐碴壓艙，合計約 5,400 噸
Choshi Offshore Demonstration (NEDO/TEPC.en: A prestressed-concrete caisson gravity base (2,400 t), towed out half-submerged and then filled with copper-slag ballast, 5,400 t in all
Choshi Offshore Demonstration (NEDO/TEPC.dz: 水深 11.9 m、機艙中心高 80.0 m、葉輪 92 m（東京電力千葉縣研究會簡報）；MWT92/2.4。
Choshi Offshore Demonstration (NEDO/TEPC.de: Water depth 11.9 m, nacelle centre 80.0 m, rotor 92 m (TEPCO briefing to Chiba Prefecture); MWT92/2.4.

Kitakyushu Offshore Demonstration (NEDO/.zh: J-POWER 的「ハイブリッド重力式」：拋石基床上放預鑄混凝土底版，上面架內填混凝土的鋼製套管；2019 年 9 月撤除風機與上部結構，底版留作研究設施
Kitakyushu Offshore Demonstration (NEDO/.en: J-Power’s “hybrid gravity” foundation: a precast concrete base slab on a rubble mound carrying a steel jacket filled with concrete; the turbine and substructure were removed in September 2019 and the base was kept as a research facility

Noshiro Port.zh: 20 座單樁配轉接段（鹿島與住友電工統包）
Noshiro Port.en: 20 monopiles with transition pieces (Kajima and Sumitomo Electric EPCI)
Noshiro Port.dz: 同秋田港計畫：水深 10～30 m（日經BP）；V117-4.2 輪轂 91.5 m、葉輪 117 m（Cosmo Eco Power）。
Noshiro Port.de: Same project as Akita Port: 10–30 m water depth (Nikkei BP); V117-4.2 hub 91.5 m, rotor 117 m (Cosmo Eco Power).

Akita Port.zh: 13 座單樁配轉接段（鹿島與住友電工統包）
Akita Port.en: 13 monopiles with transition pieces (Kajima and Sumitomo Electric EPCI)
Akita Port.dz: 日經BP：秋田港・能代港水深 10～30 m；Cosmo Eco Power 風機規格 V117-4.2 輪轂 91.5 m、葉輪 117 m。
Akita Port.de: Nikkei BP: Akita/Noshiro port sites in 10–30 m of water; Cosmo Eco Power turbine sheet V117-4.2 hub 91.5 m, rotor 117 m.

Nyuzen Offshore Wind Farm.zh: 3 座直徑 5.5 m、長 48.1–51.6 m 的單樁，不加轉接段（日本首例），清水建設設計施工
Nyuzen Offshore Wind Farm.en: 3 monopiles 5.5 m across and 48.1–51.6 m long with no transition piece (a first in Japan), designed and built by Shimizu
Nyuzen Offshore Wind Farm.dz: 日文維基：水深 10～12 m、總高 152 m、葉輪 133 m（明陽 MySE 3.0-135 級）；輪轂高度未查到；輪轂高由「海面起高度 152 m − 葉輪半徑 66.5 m（直徑 133 m）」推算；來源 Wind Journal；輪轂高度由葉尖高減葉輪半徑推算
Nyuzen Offshore Wind Farm.de: Japanese Wikipedia: 10–12 m water depth, 152 m tip height, 133 m rotor (MingYang MySE 3.0-135 class); hub height not found; Hub height derived as height above sea 152 m minus rotor radius 66.5 m (133 m diameter); source Wind Journal; hub height derived as tip height minus rotor radius

Ishikari Bay New Port.zh: 14 座四腳套管，固定在預打的鋼管樁上（海床軟弱，是日本第一座套管式離岸風場）
Ishikari Bay New Port.en: 14 four-legged jackets fixed to pre-driven steel pipe piles (chosen for the soft seabed; Japan’s first jacket-founded offshore farm)
Ishikari Bay New Port.dz: 日經BP：葉輪 167 m、機艙距平均海面約 112 m（SG 8.0-167 DD）；水深未查到。
Ishikari Bay New Port.de: Nikkei BP: rotor 167 m, nacelle about 112 m above mean sea level (SG 8.0-167 DD); water depth not found.

Kitakyushu Hibikinada.zh: 25 座套管，分 4 樁與 8 樁兩型、共 144 支樁，依海床分別用全套管、RS-plus 與打擊三種工法（水深 8–30 m）
Kitakyushu Hibikinada.en: 25 jackets in two variants (4-pile and 8-pile), 144 piles in all, installed by three methods (all-casing, RS-plus and driving) to suit the seabed, in 8–30 m of water
Kitakyushu Hibikinada.dz: offshoreWIND.biz（2025-09）：25 部 Vestas V174-9.6 MW 全部裝設完成，葉輪 174 m（Vestas 型號數字即葉輪直徑）；日文維基百科資訊框（引業主資料）：水深約 8～30 m；輪轂高度未查到（日刊工業新聞的「距海面約 200 m」是葉尖高的約略值）。
Kitakyushu Hibikinada.de: offshoreWIND.biz (Sep 2025): all 25 Vestas V174-9.6 MW installed, i.e. a 174 m rotor (the Vestas model number is the rotor diameter); Japanese Wikipedia infobox (citing the owner): water depth about 8–30 m; hub height not found (Nikkan Kogyo’s "about 200 m above the sea" is an approximate tip height).

Jeju Woljeong test (Doosan).zh: 2 部試驗機各立在鋼製套管上：能源技術研究院說明 2 MW 那座是以短基樁固定的傾斜兩段式套管；斗山 3 MW 那座只有 2019 年的產業簡報寫明型式
Jeju Woljeong test (Doosan).en: Both test turbines stand on steel jackets: KIER describes the 2 MW unit’s inclined two-stage jacket held by short pin piles, while for Doosan’s 3 MW unit only a 2019 industry presentation states the type
Jeju Woljeong test (Doosan).dz: WinDS3000：輪轂 80 m、葉輪 91.3 m（Energy Daily 耽羅專訪的機型規格）；月汀試驗場水深未查到。
Jeju Woljeong test (Doosan).de: WinDS3000: hub 80 m, rotor 91.3 m (turbine spec quoted in Energy Daily Tamra interview); Woljeong site depth not found.

Tamra (Jeju Hangyeong).zh: 10 座套管，基樁以反循環（RCD）鑽入玄武岩海床後灌漿固定
Tamra (Jeju Hangyeong).en: 10 jackets whose pin piles were drilled into the basalt seabed with reverse-circulation drilling (RCD) and grouted
Tamra (Jeju Hangyeong).dz: 韓文維基：離岸 150～170 m、水深 3.5～9 m；Energy Daily：WinDS3000 輪轂 80 m、直徑 91.3 m。
Tamra (Jeju Hangyeong).de: Korean Wikipedia: 150–170 m from shore in 3.5–9 m of water; Energy Daily: WinDS3000 hub 80 m, rotor 91.3 m.

Southwest Offshore Demonstration (Seonam.zh: 20 座套管：19 座打樁式（含 2 號機浦項的研發用套管），7 號機是韓電電力研究院的吸力桶套管
Southwest Offshore Demonstration (Seonam.en: 20 jackets: 19 piled (including POSCO’s R&D jacket under turbine 2) and one suction-bucket jacket by KEPCO’s research institute under turbine 7
Southwest Offshore Demonstration (Seonam.dz: 電子新聞：20 部中 17 部為碳纖葉片 TCS 型，葉輪 134 m（其餘 100 m）；韓國海洋環境論文（ScienceON）：實證場址離岸約 10 km、水深 10～11 m；輪轂高度未取得可引用原文。
Southwest Offshore Demonstration (Seonam.de: ET News: 17 of 20 units use the carbon-blade TCS type with 134 m rotor (others 100 m); Korean marine-environment paper (ScienceON): the site is about 10 km offshore in 10–11 m of water; no quotable source found for hub height.

Jeju Hanlim.zh: 18 座套管，採後打樁：先整平玄武岩放置套管，再以反循環（RCD）鑽孔打樁灌漿
Jeju Hanlim.en: 18 jackets, post-piled: set on pre-drilled, levelled basalt and then fixed with RCD-drilled, grouted pin piles
Jeju Hanlim.dz: KEPCO 現場報導：輪轂 110 m、葉輪 140 m，基樁於水深 43 m 處鑽入玄武岩（最深處）。
Jeju Hanlim.de: KEPCO site report: hub 110 m, rotor 140 m; piles drilled into basalt under 43 m of water (deepest point).

Yeonggwang Nakwol.zh: 64 座單樁（GS Entec 製，長 60.2–71.2 m、底部直徑 7.5 m）；韓國第一座改用單樁的大型離岸風場
Yeonggwang Nakwol.en: 64 monopiles (made by GS Entec, 60.2–71.2 m long and 7.5 m across at the base); the first large Korean farm to choose monopiles instead of jackets

Jeonnam Offshore Wind 1.zh: 10 座單樁，韓國第一座以單樁為基礎的離岸風場
Jeonnam Offshore Wind 1.en: 10 monopiles; the first monopile-founded offshore wind farm in Korea
Jeonnam Offshore Wind 1.dz: ZDNet Korea：水深 10～20 m，海面至發電機高 127 m，葉片長 97 m（SG 10.0-193 級；葉輪直徑未直接寫明）；10 部西門子歌美颯 SG 10.0-193 DD，葉輪 193 m；來源 offshoreWIND.biz。
Jeonnam Offshore Wind 1.de: ZDNet Korea: 10–20 m water depth, 127 m from sea surface to generator, 97 m blades (SG 10.0-193 class; rotor diameter not stated directly); 10 Siemens Gamesa SG 10.0-193 DD turbines, 193 m rotor; source offshoreWIND.biz.

Block Island.zh: 5 座四腳套管（各約 400 噸），以穿過套管腳打入的基樁固定；美國第一座離岸風場
Block Island.en: 5 four-legged jackets (about 400 t each) fixed by pin piles driven through the legs; the first offshore wind farm in the USA
Block Island.dz: Tethys／英文維基：Haliade 150-6 MW，輪轂 100 m、葉輪 150 m；水深未取得可引用原文；地質鑽探在約 75–100 英尺（約 23–30 m）水深進行；來源 GZA（大地工程顧問）。
Block Island.de: Tethys / English Wikipedia: Haliade 150-6 MW, hub 100 m, rotor 150 m; no quotable water-depth source; Geotechnical borings were drilled in approx. 75–100 ft (about 23–30 m) of water; source GZA (geotechnical engineer).

Coastal Virginia Offshore Wind (CVOW) Pi.zh: 2 座單樁（877 噸、直徑 7.8 m）配轉接段
Coastal Virginia Offshore Wind (CVOW) Pi.en: 2 monopiles (877 t, 7.8 m across) with transition pieces
Coastal Virginia Offshore Wind (CVOW) Pi.dz: INSPIRE Environmental：2 部 6 MW 風機，水深最深 24 m；機型 SWT-6.0-154（葉輪 154 m，依資料庫機型）；輪轂高度未查到。
Coastal Virginia Offshore Wind (CVOW) Pi.de: INSPIRE Environmental: two 6 MW turbines in water depths up to 24 m; SWT-6.0-154 (154 m rotor from model name); hub height not found.

South Fork Wind.zh: 12 座風機單樁，2023 年 6–8 月安裝（海上變電站另立在第 13 座單樁上）
South Fork Wind.en: 12 turbine monopiles installed between June and August 2023 (a 13th carries the offshore substation)
South Fork Wind.dz: Tethys：水深 33～41 m，SG 11.0-200 DD 輪轂 100.9～143.9 m（許可範圍）、葉輪 200 m。
South Fork Wind.de: Tethys: 33–41 m water depth; SG 11.0-200 DD, hub 100.9–143.9 m (permitted range), rotor 200 m.

Vineyard Wind 1.zh: 62 座風機單樁配轉接段，2023 年 6 月起安裝（海上變電站另有單樁）
Vineyard Wind 1.en: 62 turbine monopiles with transition pieces, installed from June 2023 (the offshore substation stands on its own monopile)

Coastal Virginia Offshore Wind (CVOW) Co.zh: 176 座單樁（最大直徑 9.5 m、1,538 噸），2024–2025 年安裝（3 座海上變電站另以基樁固定）
Coastal Virginia Offshore Wind (CVOW) Co.en: 176 monopiles (up to 9.5 m across and 1,538 t), installed in 2024–2025 (the three offshore substations stand on pin piles)

Revolution Wind.zh: 65 座加大型（XXL）風機單樁，2024 年 5 月至 2025 年第 2 季安裝（2 座海上變電站另有更大的單樁）
Revolution Wind.en: 65 XXL turbine monopiles installed between May 2024 and Q2 2025 (two larger monopiles carry the offshore substations)

CGN Huizhou Gangkou I & II.zh: 共104座：一期25萬kW（6.45 MW機組）2021-12-28全容量併網，二期75萬kW（PA區10×8.5＋20×12＋9×14 MW等）2023-12-12投產；新華社說該項目「創新研發了具有新型過渡段結構的深水區導管架基礎」，一期招標亦為導管架預製與施工（Ⅲ標段12套預製、20套沉樁施工），2021-07「秦航工2300」在惠州海域吊裝導管架（新華網2023-12-13、國資委2023-12-15、中國能建2023-12-18、中國電力招標網2020-06-27、搜狐2021-07-21）。
CGN Huizhou Gangkou I & II.en: 104 turbines in all: phase I 250 MW (6.45 MW units) fully grid-connected 2021-12-28, phase II 750 MW (PA block 10 x 8.5 + 20 x 12 + 9 x 14 MW etc.) commissioned 2023-12-12. Xinhua says the project ’developed a deep-water jacket foundation with a new transition-piece structure’; the phase I tenders were also for jacket prefabrication and installation (lot III: 12 jackets prefabricated, 20 driven) and in July 2021 the crane vessel Qinhanggong 2300 installed jackets in Huizhou waters (Xinhua 2023-12-13, SASAC 2023-12-15, CEEC 2023-12-18, dlztb 2020-06-27, Sohu 2021-07-21).
CGN Huizhou Gangkou I & II.dz: 港口二期水深31–40 m（廣東省水力和新能源發電工程學會轉中廣核；一期為40台6.25 MW，水深未單獨列出，全場機位水深超30 m）；輪轂高度與葉輪直徑未查得；港口一期（400 MW）64 台明陽 MySE6.45-180（葉輪 180 m，取自機型名稱）；港口二期為 8.5/12/14 MW 混合機型，葉輪直徑未查到，故 180 m 僅代表一期。
CGN Huizhou Gangkou I & II.de: Phase II water depth 31-40 m (GDSHE citing CGN; phase I is 40 x 6.25 MW with no separate depth, whole site over 30 m); hub height and rotor diameter not found; Phase I (400 MW): 64 × Mingyang MySE6.45-180 (rotor 180 m from the model name); Phase II mixes 8.5/12/14 MW units whose rotors were not found, so 180 m covers Phase I only.

Guangdong Zhanjiang Xuwen Offshore wind.zh: 原場600 MW＝94×6.45 MW，2021-11-26全部併網，報導稱「30天內完成單樁沉樁20根」（湛江日報2021-11-26）；300 MW增容＝25×12 MW，「風機基礎全部採用單樁基礎」（樁徑8.75–9.7 m），2024-12-17全容量併網（搜狐／龍船風電網2023-09-21、2024-07-03，CPEM 2024）。原場94座未見逐場型式說明，僅有單樁沉樁報導。
Guangdong Zhanjiang Xuwen Offshore wind.en: Original 600 MW = 94 x 6.45 MW, all grid-connected 2021-11-26, with reports of ’20 monopiles driven in 30 days’ (Zhanjiang Daily 2021-11-26); the 300 MW extension = 25 x 12 MW, ’all turbine foundations are monopiles’ (8.75-9.7 m diameter), fully connected 2024-12-17 (Sohu/Longchuan 2023-09-21 and 2024-07-03, CPEM 2024). No explicit statement covers all 94 original turbines, only the monopile-driving report.
Guangdong Zhanjiang Xuwen Offshore wind.dz: 水深5–26 m，94台6.45 MW（湛江日報）；機型、輪轂高度與葉輪直徑未查得。
Guangdong Zhanjiang Xuwen Offshore wind.de: Water depth 5-26 m, 94 x 6.45 MW (Zhanjiang Daily); turbine model, hub height and rotor diameter not found.

Guoxin Dafeng 850 MW.zh: 100×8.5 MW，「風機基礎全部採用大直徑單樁結構」，2025年完成100根單樁基礎施工，2025-12-29全部風機併網（查股網／交匯點2025-10-08、國資委2026）。
Guoxin Dafeng 850 MW.en: 100 x 8.5 MW; ’all turbine foundations use large-diameter monopiles’, all 100 monopiles driven in 2025 and all turbines grid-connected by 2025-12-29 (gubit/Jiaohuidian 2025-10-08, SASAC 2026).
Guoxin Dafeng 850 MW.dz: 場區水深1–42 m（新浪轉江蘇國信）；100台8.5 MW，葉輪226.5 m（中國能建）；輪轂高度未查得。
Guoxin Dafeng 850 MW.de: Site water depth 1-42 m (Sina citing Jiangsu Guoxin); 100 x 8.5 MW with 226.5 m rotor (China Energy Engineering); hub height not found.

Shandong Energy Bozhong A.zh: 60×8.35 MW（501 MW），全場單樁60根（大金重工製30根、煙台打撈局施工30台單樁基礎，2022-04-16首樁沉樁）（半島網／新華社2022-05-04、搜狐／煙台打撈局2022-04-19）。
Shandong Energy Bozhong A.en: 60 x 8.35 MW (501 MW); 60 monopiles for the whole farm (30 made by Dajin Heavy Industry, Yantai Salvage installing 30 monopile foundations; first pile driven 2022-04-16) (Bandao/Xinhua 2022-05-04, Sohu/Yantai Salvage 2022-04-19).
Shandong Energy Bozhong A.dz: 60台海裝 WTG220-8350（H220-8.35），輪轂高度126 m（CPEM 轉電建中南院），葉輪220 m（國資委）；水深未查得；A場址場區水深10–20米（山東陽光採購平台招標公告）
Shandong Energy Bozhong A.de: 60 x CSSC Haizhuang WTG220-8350 (H220-8.35), hub height 126 m (CPEM citing PowerChina Zhongnan), rotor 220 m (SASAC); water depth not found; Site water depth 10-20 m (tender notice on Shandong procurement platform)

Zhuanghe V.zh: 招商局太平灣與三峽能源的大連莊河海上風電場址V項目250 MW（24台9MW＋4台8.5MW），風機基礎全部採單樁—摩擦筒結構，2025-03-31基礎全部完工、2025-04-20主體完工（大連天健網／中新網遼寧2025-04-22、新浪財經2025-04-13；中交一航局2025-03-31報導因網站拒絕存取未能抓取）。
Zhuanghe V.en: Dalian Zhuanghe site V, 250 MW (24 x 9 MW + 4 x 8.5 MW) by China Merchants Taipingwan and CTG Energy: all turbine foundations are monopile-plus-friction-can structures; foundations finished 2025-03-31, main works 2025-04-20 (Dalian runsky/Chinanews Liaoning 2025-04-22, Sina Finance 2025-04-13; the CCCC First Harbour report of 2025-03-31 could not be fetched).
Zhuanghe V.dz: 海域水深30 m，24台9 MW＋4台8.5 MW（大連日報／天健網）；輪轂高度與葉輪直徑未查得。
Zhuanghe V.de: Water depth 30 m, 24 x 9 MW + 4 x 8.5 MW (Dalian Daily via runsky); hub height and rotor diameter not found.

CGN Yangjiang Nanpeng Island.zh: 中廣核陽江南鵬島400 MW（73台5.5MW）：四樁導管架41台、普通大直徑單樁29台、嵌岩單樁3台（合計單樁32台），2020-11-17全部73台基礎完工，2020-12中旬全容量併網（中廣核新能源2020-11-19、陽江廣播電視台2021-01-26，世紀新能源網轉載）。
CGN Yangjiang Nanpeng Island.en: CGN Yangjiang Nanpeng Island, 400 MW (73 x 5.5 MW): 41 four-pile jackets, 29 ordinary large-diameter monopiles and 3 rock-socketed monopiles (32 monopiles in total); all 73 foundations finished 2020-11-17, full grid connection mid-December 2020 (CGN New Energy 2020-11-19, Yangjiang TV 2021-01-26, via ne21).
CGN Yangjiang Nanpeng Island.dz: 車研諮詢（廣東海上風電專案表）：水深22–31 m；陽東區政府：73台5.5 MW；輪轂／葉輪未找到；Power Technology：73台明陽 MySE5.5-155（葉輪155米），塔高105米。
CGN Yangjiang Nanpeng Island.de: Cheyanzixun (Guangdong offshore project table): depth 22–31 m; Yangdong district: 73 x 5.5 MW; hub/rotor not found; Power Technology: 73 x Mingyang MySE5.5-155 (rotor 155 m), 105 m high towers.

Longyuan Sheyang H2.zh: 射陽龍源 2022-01 的招標公告（兩案「均已建成投產」）：射陽海上南區 H2# 30 萬千瓦共 67 台機組，全部為單樁基礎；2025-12 江蘇海上龍源的招標也寫「海上射陽風電場風機基礎為單管樁」。
Longyuan Sheyang H2.en: Sheyang Longyuan’s tender notice of Jan 2022 (both projects “built and in operation”): the Sheyang South H2# 300 MW project has 67 turbines, all on monopiles; a Jiangsu Offshore Longyuan tender of Dec 2025 also says the Sheyang offshore farm’s turbines stand on monopiles.
Longyuan Sheyang H2.dz: 射陽龍源 2022-01 招標公告（已建成投產）：射陽海上南區 H2＋H2-1 場區海底高程 -8～-19 m（兩案共用場區的範圍）。輪轂高度與葉輪直徑未查到（環評的 97 m／148 m 是設計值）。
Longyuan Sheyang H2.de: Sheyang Longyuan tender notice, Jan 2022 (built and operating): seabed elevation −8 to −19 m across the shared H2 + H2-1 site. Hub height and rotor not found (the EIA’s 97 m / 148 m are design values).

Jiangsu Sheyang Southern Area H2-1 Offsh.zh: 射陽龍源 2022-01 的招標公告（已建成投產）：射陽海上南區 H2-1# 10 萬千瓦共 23 台機組，全部為單樁基礎（與 H2 的 67 台是不同的項目）。
Jiangsu Sheyang Southern Area H2-1 Offsh.en: Sheyang Longyuan’s tender notice of Jan 2022 (built and in operation): the Sheyang South H2-1# 100 MW project has 23 turbines, all on monopiles (a separate project from H2’s 67).
Jiangsu Sheyang Southern Area H2-1 Offsh.dz: 射陽龍源 2022-01 招標公告：與 H2 共用場區，海底高程 -8～-19 m（兩案共用的範圍）。輪轂高度與葉輪直徑未查到。
Jiangsu Sheyang Southern Area H2-1 Offsh.de: Sheyang Longyuan tender notice, Jan 2022: shares the site with H2, seabed elevation −8 to −19 m (the range for both). Hub height and rotor not found.

Jiangsu Dafeng H4 Offshore (Longyuan) wi.zh: 龍源 2021-05 的招標公告：龍源江蘇大豐 H4# 300 MW 共 47 台機組，全部為單樁基礎；2020 年的基礎施工招標也是 47 台單樁，龍源振華承做「47 基單樁基礎包覆防腐」（2020-09）。
Jiangsu Dafeng H4 Offshore (Longyuan) wi.en: Longyuan’s tender notice of May 2021: Longyuan Jiangsu Dafeng H4# 300 MW has 47 turbines, all on monopiles; the 2020 foundation tender also covers 47 monopiles, and Longyuan Zhenhua did the anti-corrosion wrapping of the 47 monopiles (Sept 2020).
Jiangsu Dafeng H4 Offshore (Longyuan) wi.dz: 龍源鹽城新能源 2025-11 招標公告：大豐 H4 場區海底高程 -17.0～-4.1 m，竣工為 47 台 6.45 MW。輪轂高度與葉輪直徑未查到。
Jiangsu Dafeng H4 Offshore (Longyuan) wi.de: Longyuan Yancheng tender notice, Nov 2025: Dafeng H4 seabed elevation −17.0 to −4.1 m; as built, 47 × 6.45 MW. Hub height and rotor not found.

Jiangsu Dafeng H6 Offshore (Longyuan) wi.zh: 龍源 2021-05 的招標公告：龍源江蘇大豐 H6# 300 MW 共 47 台機組，全部為單樁基礎；2020 年的基礎施工招標也是 47 台單樁，另有「H6# 單樁基礎包覆防腐施工工程」（2020-10）。
Jiangsu Dafeng H6 Offshore (Longyuan) wi.en: Longyuan’s tender notice of May 2021: Longyuan Jiangsu Dafeng H6# 300 MW has 47 turbines, all on monopiles; the 2020 foundation tender also covers 47 monopiles, with a separate monopile anti-corrosion contract (Oct 2020).
Jiangsu Dafeng H6 Offshore (Longyuan) wi.dz: 龍源鹽城新能源 2025-11 招標公告：大豐 H6 場區海底高程 -17.0～-5.8 m，變更後為 47 台 6.45 MW。輪轂高度與葉輪直徑未查到。
Jiangsu Dafeng H6 Offshore (Longyuan) wi.de: Longyuan Yancheng tender notice, Nov 2025: Dafeng H6 seabed elevation −17.0 to −5.8 m; after the change, 47 × 6.45 MW. Hub height and rotor not found.

Longyuan Dafeng H7.zh: 龍源鹽城大豐 2020-10 的招標公告（已建成）：二期（H7）共 80 台機組，全部為單樁基礎；海力風電的證監會文件另列韓通與龍源振華兩個「龍源大豐 H7 單樁」供應項目。
Longyuan Dafeng H7.en: Longyuan Yancheng Dafeng’s tender notice of Oct 2020 (built): phase 2 (H7) has 80 turbines, all on monopiles; Haili Wind’s CSRC filing lists two “Longyuan Dafeng H7 monopile” supply projects (Hantong and Longyuan Zhenhua).
Longyuan Dafeng H7.dz: 龍源鹽城大豐 2020-10 招標公告（已建成）：大豐 H7 場區「大部分區域」水深 5～15 m（不是全場極值）。輪轂高度與葉輪直徑未查到。
Longyuan Dafeng H7.de: Longyuan Yancheng Dafeng tender notice, Oct 2020 (built): “most of the site” is 5–15 m deep (not the full range). Hub height and rotor not found.

Jiangsu Dafeng H12 Offshore (Longyuan) w.zh: 龍源鹽城大豐 2020-10 的招標公告（H12 於 2017–2018 年建成）：一期（H12）共 80 台機組，其中單樁基礎 40 台、導管架基礎 40 台。
Jiangsu Dafeng H12 Offshore (Longyuan) w.en: Longyuan Yancheng Dafeng’s tender notice of Oct 2020 (H12 built 2017–2018): phase 1 (H12) has 80 turbines, 40 on monopiles and 40 on jackets.

CTG Yangjiang Shapa Phase 1.zh: 沙扒一期海域使用補充論證報告書（陽江市自然資源局 2023-09 公示，已建項目）：已建 55 台明陽 5.5 MW，風機基礎為 39 台單樁、10 台四樁非嵌岩導管架、3 台單柱複合筒與 3 台吸力桶導管架（原核准的三樁與四樁導管架已調整）。
CTG Yangjiang Shapa Phase 1.en: Shapa phase 1 supplementary sea-use report (Yangjiang natural resources bureau, Sept 2023, built project): 55 Mingyang 5.5 MW turbines on 39 monopiles, 10 four-pile non-rock-socketed jackets, 3 single-column composite buckets and 3 suction-bucket jackets (the approved tripile and four-pile jacket design was changed).
CTG Yangjiang Shapa Phase 1.dz: 沙扒一期海域使用補充論證報告書（陽江市自然資源局 2023-09 公示，已建項目）：調整後參數表 MySE5.5-155 預裝輪轂高度 110 m、風輪直徑 158 m（調整前的可研值 105.7 m／157.738 m 不採用）；場址水深 27–33 m。
CTG Yangjiang Shapa Phase 1.de: Shapa phase 1 supplementary sea-use report (Yangjiang natural resources bureau, Sept 2023, built project): the adjusted parameters give the MySE5.5-155 a hub height of 110 m and a 158 m rotor (the feasibility values 105.7 m / 157.738 m are not used); site depth 27–33 m.

CTG Yangjiang Shapa Phase 3.zh: 沙扒三期海域使用補充論證報告書（陽江市自然資源局 2023-09 公示；2021-12-16 建設完成）：固定式 61 台為 22 台單樁、15 台植入式嵌岩三樁導管架、12 台非嵌岩四樁導管架、12 台高樁承台（每台 6 根樁）；另 1 台漂浮式是本站的「三峽引領號」。
CTG Yangjiang Shapa Phase 3.en: Shapa phase 3 supplementary sea-use report (Yangjiang natural resources bureau, Sept 2023; completed 16 Dec 2021): the 61 fixed turbines stand on 22 monopiles, 15 implanted rock-socketed three-pile jackets, 12 non-rock-socketed four-pile jackets and 12 high-rise pile caps (six piles each); the one floating unit is the site’s separate “Sanxia Yinling” record.
CTG Yangjiang Shapa Phase 3.dz: 沙扒三期海域使用補充論證報告書（2023-09；2021-12-16 建設完成）：調整後輪轂高度 MySE6.45-180 為 111 m、GW171/6450 為 112.5 m，風輪直徑 178／171 m（葉輪取最大 178 m；漂浮式 MySE5.5-155 的 106 m 屬「三峽引領號」）；水深 A1 區 28–32 m、A2 區 23–25 m。
CTG Yangjiang Shapa Phase 3.de: Shapa phase 3 supplementary sea-use report (Sept 2023; completed 16 Dec 2021): adjusted hub heights 111 m for the MySE6.45-180 and 112.5 m for the GW171/6450, rotors 178 / 171 m (largest 178 m; the floating MySE5.5-155’s 106 m belongs to “Sanxia Yinling”); depth 28–32 m in zone A1 and 23–25 m in zone A2.

Putian Shicheng.zh: 29 台（26 台 7 MW＋3 台 6 MW，福建省自然資源廳 2024-05）全為高樁承台：首批風機基礎施工標段共 10 座承台（世紀新能源網，2020-01），Ⅱ 標段 19 台高樁承台（中交一航局，2021-03），10＋19＝29；CPEM 轉載研報也寫石城採用高樁承台式結構。
Putian Shicheng.en: All 29 turbines (26 × 7 MW + 3 × 6 MW, Fujian natural resources department, May 2024) stand on high-rise pile caps: the first foundation lot has 10 caps (ne21, Jan 2020) and lot II 19 high-rise caps (CCCC First Harbour, Mar 2021), 10 + 19 = 29; a research note reprinted by CPEM also says Shicheng uses high-rise pile caps.

CTG Yangjiang Shapa Phase 4.zh: 43 部東方 7 MW：7 座單樁＋36 座非嵌岩四樁導管架（沙扒四期海域使用補充論證報告書，陽江市自然資源局 2023-09 公示；2020-04 開工、2021-12 建設完成，原核准的 6 單樁＋14 單柱複合筒＋27 嵌岩高樁承台已調整）。
CTG Yangjiang Shapa Phase 4.en: 43 Dongfang 7 MW turbines: 7 monopiles + 36 non-rock-socketed four-pile jackets (Shapa phase 4 supplementary sea-use report, Yangjiang natural resources bureau, Sept 2023; built Apr 2020 – Dec 2021; the approved 6 monopiles + 14 composite buckets + 27 rock-socketed pile caps were changed).
CTG Yangjiang Shapa Phase 4.dz: 沙扒四期海域使用補充論證報告書（陽江市自然資源局 2023-09 公示；2021-12 建設完成）：43 台東方 DEW-D7000-186，調整後參數表預裝輪轂高度 113 m、風輪直徑 186 m；場址水深 27–31 m。
CTG Yangjiang Shapa Phase 4.de: Shapa phase 4 supplementary sea-use report (Yangjiang natural resources bureau, Sept 2023; completed Dec 2021): 43 Dongfang DEW-D7000-186, adjusted parameters hub height 113 m, rotor 186 m; site depth 27–31 m.

CTG Yangjiang Shapa Phase 5.zh: 47 部 6.45 MW：高樁承台 11、導管架 23（非嵌岩 14、芯柱式嵌岩 5、吸力桶 4）、單柱複合筒 13（含 4 座需加配重）（沙扒五期海域使用補充論證報告書，陽江市自然資源局 2023-09 公示，已建項目）。
CTG Yangjiang Shapa Phase 5.en: 47 × 6.45 MW: 11 high-rise pile caps, 23 jackets (14 non-rock-socketed, 5 core-column rock-socketed, 4 suction-bucket) and 13 single-column composite buckets (4 of them ballasted) (Shapa phase 5 supplementary sea-use report, Yangjiang natural resources bureau, Sept 2023, built project).
CTG Yangjiang Shapa Phase 5.dz: 沙扒五期海域使用補充論證報告書（陽江市自然資源局 2023-09 公示，已建項目）：場址水深 25–28 m；報告只寫最終機型的葉輪與輪轂「與可研階段有差異」、沒有數值（「輪轂高度初定為 100m」是可研值，不採用）。
CTG Yangjiang Shapa Phase 5.de: Shapa phase 5 supplementary sea-use report (Yangjiang natural resources bureau, Sept 2023, built project): site depth 25–28 m; the report only says the final model’s rotor and hub differ from the feasibility study, without figures (its “hub height initially 100 m” is a feasibility value, not used).

CTG Yangjiang Shapa Phase 2.zh: 三峽陽江沙扒二期400 MW（62台6.45MW，水深28–32 m），2021-11-27全部機組投產。基礎為導管架：項目設計四樁非嵌岩導管架、芯柱式嵌岩三樁導管架、植入式嵌岩導管架多種型式（三峽新能源2020-08-31），投產報導稱完成國內首個大直徑非嵌岩四樁導管架與芯柱嵌岩三樁導管架施工（三峽能源珠江公司2021-11-29，世紀新能源網轉載）。各型式座數未查到。
CTG Yangjiang Shapa Phase 2.en: CTG Yangjiang Shapa phase 2, 400 MW (62 x 6.45 MW, 28–32 m water depth), all units in operation 2021-11-27. Jacket foundations: the project designed four-pile non-rock-socketed jackets, core-pile rock-socketed three-pile jackets and implanted rock-socketed jackets (CTG New Energy 2020-08-31); the commissioning report cites China’s first large-diameter non-rock-socketed four-pile jackets and core-pile rock-socketed three-pile jackets (CTG Energy Pearl River 2021-11-29, via ne21). Counts per jacket type not found.
CTG Yangjiang Shapa Phase 2.dz: 沙扒二期海域使用補充論證報告書（陽江市自然資源局 2023-09 公示，已建項目）：場址水深 21–26 m；62 台 6.45 MW，調整後設備表 MySE6.45-180 風輪直徑 178 m、GW171/6450 為 171 m，葉輪取最大 178 m（型號數字不等於直徑）。同表輪轂高度 111／109 m 的欄名是「輪轂高度（推薦）」，不採用。世紀新能源網寫的 28–32 m 改以報告為準。
CTG Yangjiang Shapa Phase 2.de: Shapa phase 2 supplementary sea-use report (Yangjiang natural resources bureau, Sept 2023, built project): site depth 21–26 m; 62 × 6.45 MW, with the adjusted equipment table giving 178 m rotors for MySE6.45-180 and 171 m for GW171/6450, so 178 m (the model number is not the diameter). The table’s 111 / 109 m hub heights are headed “hub height (recommended)” and are not used. ne21’s 28–32 m is replaced by the report.

Liaoning Dalian Zhuanghe 4 Area I Offsho.zh: 51 台（26×7.5 MW＋25×6.2 MW，惠生海工）；中新網 2021-07-02：單根鋼管樁（頂徑 6.5 m、底徑 7.2 m、長 78 m、1080 t）即為 2 號機位的基礎結構，為大直徑單樁；2021-12-29 全容量併網（新華網）。新華網另註明吸力桶導管架用於 Ⅱ 風場，非 Ⅳ1。
Liaoning Dalian Zhuanghe 4 Area I Offsho.en: 51 turbines (26 x 7.5 MW + 25 x 6.2 MW, Wison). China News 2021-07-02: a single steel pile (6.5 m top, 7.2 m bottom, 78 m, 1,080 t) is the foundation of turbine no. 2, i.e. a large-diameter monopile; full grid connection 2021-12-29 (Xinhua). Xinhua notes the suction-bucket jackets were used at site II, not IV-1.
Liaoning Dalian Zhuanghe 4 Area I Offsho.dz: 平均水深30 m，25台6.2 MW＋26台7.5 MW（國資委）；輪轂高度與葉輪直徑未查得。
Liaoning Dalian Zhuanghe 4 Area I Offsho.de: Average water depth 30 m, 25 x 6.2 MW + 26 x 7.5 MW (SASAC); hub height and rotor diameter not found.

Shanghai Jinshan Offshore wind farm.zh: 36 根單樁基礎、36 台 8.5 MW（中交三航局施工內容，風能產業網 2025）；2025-09-23 全容量併網（人民網上海 2025-09-25）。
Shanghai Jinshan Offshore wind farm.en: 36 monopile foundations for 36 x 8.5 MW turbines (CCCC Third Harbour scope, cweea.com.cn 2025); full grid connection 2025-09-23 (People’s Daily Shanghai, 2025-09-25).
Shanghai Jinshan Offshore wind farm.dz: 水深7.8–10.5 m（上海市發改委競配方案）；36台8.5 MW；輪轂高度與葉輪直徑未查得。
Shanghai Jinshan Offshore wind farm.de: Water depth 7.8-10.5 m (Shanghai DRC competitive allocation scheme); 36 x 8.5 MW; hub height and rotor diameter not found.

Guangdong Yangjiang Nanpengdao (China En.zh: 55 台 5.5 MW 全部採四樁導管架（中國節能集團 2025-06；新浪財經轉陽江日報 2023）；2021-11 全容量投產。
Guangdong Yangjiang Nanpengdao (China En.en: All 55 x 5.5 MW turbines on four-pile jackets (CECEP group, June 2025; Sina citing Yangjiang Daily, 2023); fully commissioned Nov 2021.
Guangdong Yangjiang Nanpengdao (China En.dz: 水深23–32 m，55台5.5 MW（新浪財經轉陽江日報）；輪轂高度與葉輪直徑未查得。
Guangdong Yangjiang Nanpengdao (China En.de: Water depth 23-32 m, 55 x 5.5 MW (Sina Finance citing Yangjiang Daily); hub height and rotor diameter not found.

Zhejiang Shengsi 5, 6 Offshore wind farm.zh: 中廣核嵊泗5#6#：45 台 6.25MW 風機全部採八樁高樁承台基礎，360 根鋼管樁 2021-02-02 沉樁收官（中廣核新能源稿，中國海上風電網 2021-02-03）。
Zhejiang Shengsi 5, 6 Offshore wind farm.en: CGN Shengsi 5/6: all 45 × 6.25 MW turbines on eight-pile high-rise pile-cap foundations; the 360th and last pile was driven on 2021-02-02 (CGN New Energy release via offshorecable.com.cn, 2021-02-03).
Zhejiang Shengsi 5, 6 Offshore wind farm.dz: 中廣核嵊泗 7 號環評報告書表 3.2.2-4 的類比欄「嵊泗5#6#風電」：海域水深 12.5–14.5 m；輪轂高度與葉輪直徑未查到。
Zhejiang Shengsi 5, 6 Offshore wind farm.de: Table 3.2.2-4 of the CGN Shengsi 7 EIA report, comparison column “Shengsi 5#6#”: sea depth 12.5–14.5 m; hub height and rotor diameter not found.

Guodian Zhoushan Putuo 6#2.zh: 國電電力舟山普陀6號2區：63 台西門子 4MW 風機採「高樁高承台改進型」基礎，2019-04 全部併網（國家能源集團 2020-06）。
Guodian Zhoushan Putuo 6#2.en: Guodian Power Zhoushan Putuo 6 Zone 2: 63 Siemens 4 MW turbines on an improved high-pile high-cap foundation, fully grid-connected April 2019 (CHN Energy, June 2020).
Guodian Zhoushan Putuo 6#2.dz: 國資委（中國電建稿）：六橫島東南海域，水深12–16 m，63台4.0 MW；機型與輪轂未找到；Power Technology：63台 SWT 4.0-130（葉輪130米），塔筒高68米（塔高，非海平面起算輪轂高度）。
Guodian Zhoushan Putuo 6#2.de: SASAC (PowerChina release): southeast of Liuheng Island, depth 12–16 m, 63 x 4.0 MW; model and hub not found; Power Technology: 63 x SWT 4.0-130 (rotor 130 m), 68 m high towers (tower height, not hub height above sea level).

Guangdong Energy Zhanjiang Wailuo Phase.zh: 粵電湛江外羅 198MW：36 台 5.5MW，36 根大直徑單樁 2019-05-20 全部沉樁完成（中國能建稿，國資委 2019-05-28）。
Guangdong Energy Zhanjiang Wailuo Phase.en: Guangdong Energy Zhanjiang Wailuo 198 MW: 36 × 5.5 MW turbines, all 36 large-diameter monopiles driven by 2019-05-20 (China Energy Engineering release via SASAC, 2019-05-28).
Guangdong Energy Zhanjiang Wailuo Phase.dz: 南方網：36台5.5 MW，輪轂中心高100 m，葉輪直徑158 m；機型 MySE5.5-155 的「155」只是型號名稱，明陽產品規格表與浙商證券報告都寫這款機型葉輪直徑 158 m；水深未找到。
Guangdong Energy Zhanjiang Wailuo Phase.de: Southcn: 36 x 5.5 MW, hub centre 100 m, rotor 158 m; the '155' in MySE5.5-155 is only the model name, as Mingyang's spec sheet and a Zheshang Securities report both give this model a 158 m rotor; depth not found.

Guoneng Dafeng H5.zh: 32台GW184-6.45MW、206.4MW，風機基礎全部採無過渡段單樁（華電重工／世紀新能源網 2021-01-05；大豐區政府 2024-12）；2021年12月全容量併網（江蘇省國資委 2022-04）。
Guoneng Dafeng H5.en: 32 x GW184-6.45 MW, 206.4 MW; all turbine foundations are monopiles without transition piece (Huadian Heavy Industries via ne21.com, 5 Jan 2021; Dafeng district government, Dec 2024); full grid connection Dec 2021 (Jiangsu SASAC, Apr 2022).
Guoneng Dafeng H5.dz: 世紀新能源網（風機採購招標）：水深15–20 m、離岸67 km；實際安裝32台6.45 MW，機型／輪轂／葉輪未找到；大豐區政府：32台金風 GW184-6.45MW 機組（機型名稱葉輪直徑 184 m）。
Guoneng Dafeng H5.de: ne21 (turbine tender): depth 15–20 m, 67 km offshore; 32 x 6.45 MW installed, model/hub/rotor not found; Dafeng district government: 32 Goldwind GW184-6.45MW turbines (184 m rotor per model name).

Guangdong Energy Zhanjiang Wailuo Phase.zh: 200MW、32台6.25MW機組，採大直徑單樁基礎（樁重817t、長64m），2021-09-06全部吊裝完成（世紀新能源網 2021-09）。
Guangdong Energy Zhanjiang Wailuo Phase.en: 200 MW, 32 x 6.25 MW turbines on large-diameter monopiles (817 t, 64 m); all 32 installed by 6 Sep 2021 (ne21.com, Sep 2021).
Guangdong Energy Zhanjiang Wailuo Phase.dz: 世紀新能源網：32台6.25 MW，輪轂中心高105 m，葉輪直徑172 m；水深未找到；NS Energy（LOC 得標新聞，規劃階段）：外羅二期等風場安裝水深最深19米（只有上限）。
Guangdong Energy Zhanjiang Wailuo Phase.de: ne21: 32 x 6.25 MW, hub centre 105 m, rotor 172 m; depth not found; NS Energy (LOC contract news, planning stage): Wailuo II installed in water depths of up to 19 m (maximum only).

Jiangsu Dongtai Zhugensha H1 Offshore wi.zh: 國華竹根沙H1# 200MW、50台4.0MW，風機基礎鋼管樁全由泰勝藍島承製，2021-05-04最後一套單樁交付（南通泰勝藍島 2021-05-08）。
Jiangsu Dongtai Zhugensha H1 Offshore wi.en: Guohua Zhugensha H1#: 200 MW, 50 x 4.0 MW; all turbine foundation piles built by Taisheng Landao, the last monopile delivered on 4 May 2021 (Nantong Taisheng Landao, 8 May 2021).

Donghai Bridge Phase II.zh: 二期 28 台（27 台上海電氣 3.6MW＋1 台華銳 5MW）2015 年 2 月 12 日併網（澎湃新聞 2019）；鑒衡認證專文（geoseu.cn）指東海大橋風電場全場 20.4 萬千瓦、安裝 3.0MW 與 5.0MW 機組，採用斜高樁承台基礎。
Donghai Bridge Phase II.en: Phase II’s 28 units (27 x Sewind 3.6 MW + 1 x Sinovel 5 MW) were grid-connected on 12 Feb 2015 (The Paper, 2019); the CGC certification article on geoseu.cn states the whole 204 MW Donghai Bridge farm (3.0 MW and 5.0 MW units) uses inclined high-pile concrete cap foundations.
Donghai Bridge Phase II.dz: 國家能源局：平均水深11 m，27台上海電氣3.6 MW＋1台華銳5 MW；葉輪116 m取自上海電氣3.6 MW機型（風輪直徑116 m）的報導，非逐場數據；輪轂高度待查。
Donghai Bridge Phase II.de: NEA: average depth 11 m; 27 Shanghai Electric 3.6 MW + 1 Sinovel 5 MW. Rotor 116 m comes from the report on the Shanghai Electric 3.6 MW model (rotor 116 m), not a farm-specific figure; hub height not found.

Shanghai Lingang Demonstration Phase 1.zh: 一期示範項目 25 台 4MW（上海電氣 W4000）全部採用高樁承台：遠東集團 2019 年報導「從沉樁、承台澆築到完成全部 25 台風機安裝」，2018 年 5 月 8 日開工、主體 238 天完成。
Shanghai Lingang Demonstration Phase 1.en: The 25 x 4 MW (Sewind W4000) Phase 1 demonstration project used high-pile concrete caps: Far East Group (2019) reports ’from pile driving and cap pouring to installing all 25 turbines’ in 238 days after the 8 May 2018 start.
Shanghai Lingang Demonstration Phase 1.dz: 上海交大海科院：平均水深5–7 m；遠東集團：25台4 MW（W4000-136-90），葉輪136 m、輪轂90 m。
Shanghai Lingang Demonstration Phase 1.de: SJTU marine institute: average depth 5–7 m; Far East Group: 25 x 4 MW (W4000-136-90), rotor 136 m, hub 90 m.

Shanghai Lingang Demonstration Phase 2.zh: 二期 28 部 3.6 MW（100.8 MW）的風機基礎為高樁混凝土承台，每座 8 根斜鋼管樁沿直徑 10 m 圓周布置（施工單位中交三航局科研院 2018 年承台混凝土控裂論文，上海市土木工程學會）。
Shanghai Lingang Demonstration Phase 2.en: The 28 × 3.6 MW (100.8 MW) Phase 2 turbines stand on high-rise concrete pile caps, each on eight raked steel piles spaced around a 10 m circle (2018 crack-control paper by the contractor, CCCC Third Harbour’s research institute, Shanghai Society of Civil Engineering).

SPIC Binhai North H1.zh: 25 台西門子 4MW 全部採用 6m 以上超大直徑無過渡段單樁（國內首次），2015 年 10 月 3 日開工、2016 年 6 月 6 日整體投運（中國電器工業協會 2017 年 11 月，轉載國家優質工程金獎報導）。
SPIC Binhai North H1.en: All 25 Siemens 4 MW units stand on >6 m diameter transition-piece-free monopiles (a first in China); construction 3 Oct 2015 to full operation 6 Jun 2016 (CEEIA, Nov 2017, on the National Quality Engineering Gold Award).
SPIC Binhai North H1.dz: 國家優質工程獎網頁：水深10 m，25台西門子SWT-4.0-130（葉輪130 m）；輪轂高度未找到；新浪財經（國家電投新能源REIT招募資料）：25台西門子4.0MW，葉輪直徑130米，輪轂高度90米（平均海面以上）。
SPIC Binhai North H1.de: National Quality Engineering Award page: depth 10 m, 25 x Siemens SWT-4.0-130 (rotor 130 m); hub height not found; Sina Finance (SPIC new-energy REIT): 25 x Siemens 4.0 MW, rotor 130 m, hub height 90 m above mean sea level.
