Fuqing Xinghua Bay Phase 1 (demo).zh: 樣機試驗風場 14 台（7 家廠商，5–6.7MW，共 79.4MW）全部採用大直徑直高樁承台基礎（鑒衡認證專文，geoseu.cn；水深 5–16m、淺覆蓋層）。
Fuqing Xinghua Bay Phase 1 (demo).en: All 14 prototype units (7 makers, 5-6.7 MW, 79.4 MW) stand on large-diameter vertical high-pile concrete caps (CGC certification article on geoseu.cn; 5-16 m water, shallow overburden).
Fuqing Xinghua Bay Phase 1 (demo).dz: 東南大學地基所文章：興化灣樣機試驗風場水深約5–16 m；14台不同機型（5–6.7 MW），無統一輪轂／葉輪數值。
Fuqing Xinghua Bay Phase 1 (demo).de: Geoseu article: Xinghua Bay prototype test site water depth about 5–16 m; 14 turbines of different models (5–6.7 MW), no single hub/rotor figure.

Bến Tre 10 Bình Đại 1 Offshore wind farm.zh: Gulf 旗下湄公風電平大風場：2020-11 開工打設單樁（越南首個 monopile 專案）；PTSC PPS 2023 年基礎檢查資料寫全場 31 座、單樁直徑 5.5 m、總容量 128 MW。
Bến Tre 10 Bình Đại 1 Offshore wind farm.en: Gulf’s Mekong Wind Power Binh Dai farm: monopile installation began Nov 2020 (first monopile project in Vietnam); PTSC PPS 2023 foundation-inspection notice gives 31 turbines on 5.5 m monopiles for the 128 MW plant.

Thanh Hải No. 5 Offshore wind farm.zh: 新環球檳椥（Tân Hoàn Cầu Bến Tre）5號風場：成海1–4 共 28 座、120 MW（EVN 2022-07）；黎蒂建設負責「打設 D800 預應力混凝土樁並完成基礎」，一期 7 座、二期 21 座，即 PHC 群樁＋承台。
Thanh Hải No. 5 Offshore wind farm.en: Tan Hoan Cau Ben Tre’s No. 5 farm (Thanh Hai 1–4, 28 turbines, 120 MW per EVN, Jul 2022): contractor Le Thy drove D800 prestressed concrete piles and finished the foundations for phase 1 (7 units) and phase 2 (21 units), i.e. PHC pile group with cap.
Thanh Hải No. 5 Offshore wind farm.dz: 一、二期（共 14 部）為西門子歌美颯 SG 4.5-145，葉輪 145 m；全案 28 部，其餘機組機型未見出處。來源 GlobalData/power-technology。
Thanh Hải No. 5 Offshore wind farm.de: Phases 1–2 (14 units) are Siemens Gamesa SG 4.5-145, 145 m rotor; the project has 28 units and the rest are not sourced. Source GlobalData/power-technology.

Dong Hai 1 – Tra Vinh (Trungnam).zh: 中南集團茶榮東海1號 25 座：分包商北中南建設說明基礎為預應力離心混凝土樁（每座 34 支 D1000 或 44 支 D800）加鋼筋混凝土承台，2021-02～07 施工。
Dong Hai 1 – Tra Vinh (Trungnam).en: Trungnam’s Dong Hai 1 (Tra Vinh), 25 turbines: subcontractor Bac Trung Nam states foundations are prestressed spun concrete piles (34×D1000 or 44×D800 per foundation) with a reinforced-concrete cap, built Feb–Jul 2021.
Dong Hai 1 – Tra Vinh (Trungnam).dz: 政府電子報：75 片葉片於 105 m 高處組裝到塔上（塔高）；Trungnam：25 部 4 MW；水深未查到；25 部西門子歌美颯 SG 5.0-145（資料庫寫 SG 4.0-145），葉輪 145 m；來源 offshoreWIND.biz。施工商 Bac Trung Nam 頁面寫葉輪 150 m，與廠商不符，未採用。水深查不到。
Dong Hai 1 – Tra Vinh (Trungnam).de: Government e-portal: 75 blades fitted to towers at 105 m (tower height); Trungnam: 25 x 4 MW; water depth not found; 25 Siemens Gamesa SG 5.0-145 (stored as SG 4.0-145), 145 m rotor; source offshoreWIND.biz. Contractor Bac Trung Nam's page says 150 m, conflicting with the OEM order, not used. Depth not found.

Tan Phu Dong 1 (Tien Giang, GEC).zh: GEC 新富東1號 24 座（PC1 EPC，2022-10 裝完最後一座）：黎蒂建設承做 PHC D800 樁打設，建設雜誌 2022-05 報導 24 座基礎供應混凝土，即 PHC 群樁＋承台。
Tan Phu Dong 1 (Tien Giang, GEC).en: GEC’s Tan Phu Dong 1, 24 turbines (PC1 EPC, last turbine Oct 2022): Le Thy drove PHC D800 piles for the turbine foundations and Tap chi Xay dung (May 2022) reports concrete supply for 24 foundations, i.e. PHC pile group with cap.
Tan Phu Dong 1 (Tien Giang, GEC).dz: 物流承包商 Infinity Logistics 專案頁：24 部 Vestas V150-4.2 MW，葉輪 150 m；水深與輪轂高度未查到。
Tan Phu Dong 1 (Tien Giang, GEC).de: Project page of the logistics contractor Infinity Logistics: 24 Vestas V150-4.2 MW turbines, rotor 150 m; water depth and hub height not found.

Dong Hai 1 Offshore wind farm.zh: 北方能源薄寮東海1號 26 座 Vestas V150-4.0（一期 13＋二期 13）：PLC 公司說明在薄寮東海1號與和平1、2 打設 63–76 m 超長 PHC D800 樁作風機基礎，即 PHC 群樁＋承台。
Dong Hai 1 Offshore wind farm.en: Bac Phuong’s Dong Hai 1 (Bac Lieu), 26 Vestas V150-4.0 (13+13): piling contractor PLC states it drove 63–76 m PHC D800 piles for the turbine foundations at Dong Hai 1 and Hoa Binh 1 & 2 in Bac Lieu, i.e. PHC pile group with cap.
Dong Hai 1 Offshore wind farm.dz: Bac Phuong 的東海1號（薄遼）兩期各 13 部 Vestas V150-4.2 MW，共 100 MW，葉輪 150 m；來源 offshoreWIND.biz。
Dong Hai 1 Offshore wind farm.de: Bac Phuong's Dong Hai 1 (Bac Lieu): two phases of 13 Vestas V150-4.2 MW each, 100 MW, 150 m rotor; source offshoreWIND.biz.

Tan Thuan (PECC2) Phase 1+2.zh: 金甌新順 75 MW、18 座（PECC2 EPC，2021-10-30 COD）：潘武集團承做全部 18 座的混凝土樁打設與承台，2021-05 樁全部完成，即混凝土群樁＋承台。
Tan Thuan (PECC2) Phase 1+2.en: Tan Thuan 75 MW, 18 turbines (PECC2 EPC, COD 30 Oct 2021): Phan Vu supplied and drove the concrete piles and finished the caps for all 18 foundations, piling complete May 2021, i.e. concrete pile group with cap.
Tan Thuan (PECC2) Phase 1+2.dz: Báo Đầu tư：18 部風機位於海上，最遠離岸 5.3 km；水深、輪轂、葉輪未查到；西門子歌美颯 SG 5.0-145，葉輪 145 m；資料庫機型「Envision」有誤。來源 Siemens Gamesa 新聞稿。
Tan Thuan (PECC2) Phase 1+2.de: Bao Dau Tu: 18 turbines at sea, farthest 5.3 km from shore; no depth, hub or rotor figures found; Siemens Gamesa SG 5.0-145, 145 m rotor; stored turbine 'Envision' is wrong. Source Siemens Gamesa press release.

Hiep Thanh (Tra Vinh).zh: 協成 18 部西門子歌美颯 4.3 MW：廣州打撈局 2021 年 8 月完成協成與茶榮 V1-2 兩場「全部單樁基礎」的安裝（offshoreWIND.biz 2021-08-27）。
Hiep Thanh (Tra Vinh).en: Hiep Thanh, 18 Siemens Gamesa 4.3 MW: Guangzhou Salvage Bureau finished installing "all monopile foundations" at Hiep Thanh and Tra Vinh V1-2 in August 2021 (offshoreWIND.biz, 27 Aug 2021).
Hiep Thanh (Tra Vinh).dz: Siemens Gamesa 新聞稿（2020-07）：協成風場裝 18 部 SG 5.0-145；產品頁：SG 5.0-145 葉輪直徑 145 m（本場以 4.3 MW 運轉，葉輪不變）。水深與輪轂高度未查到。
Hiep Thanh (Tra Vinh).de: Siemens Gamesa press release (Jul 2020): Hiep Thanh has 18 SG 5.0-145; product page: the SG 5.0-145 has a 145 m rotor (run at 4.3 MW here, same rotor). Water depth and hub height not found.

Hoa Binh 1 Phase 1.zh: 方英集團和平1號一期 13 座 Vestas（2021-07-02 送電）：PLC 與 Vinaincon 均記載和平1、2 風機基礎為 PHC D500C／D800C 預應力離心混凝土樁，即群樁＋承台。
Hoa Binh 1 Phase 1.en: Phuong Anh’s Hoa Binh 1 phase 1, 13 Vestas turbines (energised 2 Jul 2021): PLC and Vinaincon both record PHC D500C/D800C prestressed spun concrete piles for the Hoa Binh 1 & 2 turbine foundations, i.e. pile group with cap.
Hoa Binh 1 Phase 1.dz: 僅查到 PLC 施工頁：Hòa Bình 1、2 採 63～76 m 的 PHC D800 樁；水深、輪轂、葉輪皆未查到；Vestas 供應 13 部 V150-4.2 MW，葉輪 150 m；資料庫機型「Goldwind」有誤。來源 offshoreWIND.biz。
Hoa Binh 1 Phase 1.de: Only the PLC contractor page found: 63–76 m PHC D800 piles at Hoa Binh 1 and 2; no depth, hub or rotor figures; Vestas supplied 13 V150-4.2 MW turbines (150 m rotor); the stored turbine 'Goldwind' is wrong. Source offshoreWIND.biz.

Hoa Binh 1 Phase 2.zh: 和平1號二期 13 座（和平1號二期＋和平2號共 26 座，2021-08-05 送電；業主方英集團）：基礎同一期，PHC 預應力混凝土樁群＋承台。
Hoa Binh 1 Phase 2.en: Hoa Binh 1 phase 2, 13 turbines (26 turbines across HB1-II and HB2, energised 5 Aug 2021; owner Phuong Anh): same PHC prestressed concrete pile-group foundations as phase 1.
Hoa Binh 1 Phase 2.dz: 二期同樣 13 部 Vestas V150-4.2 MW，葉輪 150 m；資料庫機型「Goldwind」有誤。來源 Vestas 新聞稿。
Hoa Binh 1 Phase 2.de: Phase 2 also uses 13 Vestas V150-4.2 MW (150 m rotor); stored turbine 'Goldwind' is wrong. Source Vestas press release.

Hoa Binh 2.zh: 和平2號 13 座（2021-09-15 送電，和平1、2 共 39 座；業主方英集團）：PHC 預應力混凝土樁群＋承台。
Hoa Binh 2.en: Hoa Binh 2, 13 turbines (energised 15 Sep 2021; 39 turbines across Hoa Binh 1 & 2; owner Phuong Anh): PHC prestressed concrete pile group with cap.
Hoa Binh 2.dz: 和平1號與和平2號合計 39 部機組（Đầu tư 報），吊裝商明煌寫兩案共 39 部 Vestas V150 4.2MW，故葉輪 150 m；資料庫機型「Goldwind」有誤。
Hoa Binh 2.de: Hoa Binh 1 and 2 total 39 turbines (Báo Đầu tư); the crane contractor Minh Hoang lists 39 Vestas V150 4.2 MW for the two, so 150 m rotor; stored turbine 'Goldwind' is wrong.

V1-2 Truong Long Hoa (Tra Vinh).zh: V1-2 48 MW、12 座：長城越南集團（TTVN）與企業論壇報 2021 年記載採 5.5 m 直徑鋼製單樁（monopile）以法蘭螺栓接塔，12/12 全部完成。
V1-2 Truong Long Hoa (Tra Vinh).en: V1-2, 48 MW, 12 turbines: TTVN Group and Dien dan Doanh nghiep (2021) record 5.5 m diameter steel monopiles bolted to the tower via a flange, all 12 erected.
V1-2 Truong Long Hoa (Tra Vinh).dz: 12 部金風 GW155-4.5 MW，葉輪 155 m；資料庫機型「Envision」有誤。來源 offshoreWIND.biz。
V1-2 Truong Long Hoa (Tra Vinh).de: 12 Goldwind GW155-4.5 MW, 155 m rotor; stored turbine 'Envision' is wrong. Source offshoreWIND.biz.

V1-3 Truong Long Hoa 48 MW (REE, Tra Vin.zh: REE 茶榮 V1-3 48 MW：FECON 承做 PHC D800C／D500C 樁與風機基礎，越南土力學會論文列「12 móng cọc PHC（D m = 21,5 m）」，即 PHC 群樁＋承台。
V1-3 Truong Long Hoa 48 MW (REE, Tra Vin.en: REE’s Tra Vinh V1-3, 48 MW: FECON drove PHC D800C/D500C piles and built the turbine foundations; the VSSMGE paper lists 12 PHC pile foundations (21.5 m cap diameter), i.e. PHC pile group with cap.
V1-3 Truong Long Hoa 48 MW (REE, Tra Vin.dz: Vestas 統包，12 部 V150-4.2 MW（4.0 MW 模式），葉輪 150 m；資料庫機型「Siemens Gamesa」有誤。來源 offshoreWIND.biz。海事保證商 LOC（ABL 集團，2021-03）：潮間帶，水深 3–7 m（依潮汐與位置）。
V1-3 Truong Long Hoa 48 MW (REE, Tra Vin.de: Vestas EPC, 12 V150-4.2 MW (4.0 MW mode), 150 m rotor; stored turbine 'Siemens Gamesa' is wrong. Source offshoreWIND.biz. Marine warranty surveyor LOC (ABL Group, Mar 2021): intertidal, 3–7 m of water depending on tide and location.

V1-1 Truong Long Hoa (Tra Vinh).zh: 韓國－茶榮一期 12 部 Vestas V150-4.2：Vestas 統包合約寫風機裝在「架高於海面、以多樁支撐」的強化基座上、以引橋連岸，即群樁＋承台；VIR 2020-09 寫 12 座風機基礎與 4.2 km 引橋已成形，潘武集團供應 D500／D600／D800 預應力混凝土樁給土建承包商 Khang Đức（投資報落成報導）。
V1-1 Truong Long Hoa (Tra Vinh).en: Korea–Tra Vinh phase 1, 12 Vestas V150-4.2: Vestas’ turnkey contract says the turbines sit on reinforced foundations "raised above sea level on multi-pile structures" and linked to shore by bridges, i.e. a pile group with a cap; VIR (Sept 2020) reports the 12 turbine foundations and a 4.2 km access bridge in place, and Phan Vu supplied D500/D600/D800 prestressed concrete piles to the civil contractor Khang Duc (Bao Dau tu inauguration report).
V1-1 Truong Long Hoa (Tra Vinh).dz: Vestas 統包合約：12 部 V150-4.2 MW；Vestas 產品頁：V150-4.2 葉輪直徑 150 m。水深與輪轂高度未查到。
V1-1 Truong Long Hoa (Tra Vinh).de: Vestas turnkey contract: 12 V150-4.2 MW; Vestas product page: the V150-4.2 has a 150 m rotor. Water depth and hub height not found.

Soc Trang 7 Phase 1.zh: 春球朔莊7號一期 7 座 4.2 MW（2021-10 運轉）：建設報 2024-04 寫「多樁基礎，每座由 40 支混凝土樁組成」，即混凝土群樁＋承台。
Soc Trang 7 Phase 1.en: Xuan Cau’s Soc Trang No. 7 phase 1, 7 × 4.2 MW (operating since Oct 2021): Bao Xay dung (Apr 2024) reports multi-pile foundations with 40 concrete piles per turbine, i.e. concrete pile group with cap.
Soc Trang 7 Phase 1.dz: Báo Xây dựng：每部 4.2 MW、高 105 m（塔高）、7 部建於海上；水深與葉輪未查到；7 部 Vestas V150-4.2 MW，葉輪 150 m；來源 NS Energy。
Soc Trang 7 Phase 1.de: Bao Xay Dung: 4.2 MW each, 105 m tall (tower), 7 units at sea; depth and rotor not found; Seven Vestas V150-4.2 MW, 150 m rotor; source NS Energy.

VPL Ben Tre (Nexif Ben Tre 1).zh: VPL 檳椥一期 30 MW（平大縣淺水區）：潘武集團供應 D800C 離心混凝土樁（客戶陸路3公司），即混凝土群樁＋承台；座數未查到。
VPL Ben Tre (Nexif Ben Tre 1).en: VPL Ben Tre phase 1, 30 MW (shallow water, Binh Dai): Phan Vu supplied D800C spun concrete piles (client Lung Lo 3), i.e. concrete pile group with cap; turbine count not found.
VPL Ben Tre (Nexif Ben Tre 1).dz: Vestas V150-4.2MW（7 部），葉輪 150 m；來源 OEI（安裝駁船承包商）。
VPL Ben Tre (Nexif Ben Tre 1).de: Vestas V150-4.2MW (7 units), 150 m rotor; source OEI (installation barge contractor).

CTG Fujian Changle Waihai A.zh: 37座風機全部為套管（導管架），分四樁導管架與吸力式導管架兩種：中鐵大橋局2020年9月安裝國內首台深水四樁導管架，泰勝藍島承製A區10MW四樁導管架，全場風機基礎鋼管樁直徑僅3.0–3.5 m（導管架樁），未見單樁；中鐵大橋局2021年11月寫A區「有四樁導管架、吸力式導管架」，3天吊裝5座深水吸力式導管架，惠生海工也交付A、C區共11座三筒吸力樁導管架（各種座數未查到）；37台＝6.7MW×14＋8MW×13＋10MW×10（澎湃新聞2020-09-15、世紀新能源網2020-11-20、2021-05、百家號2021-11、惠生海工）。
CTG Fujian Changle Waihai A.en: All 37 turbines on jackets, of two kinds, four-pile and suction-bucket: CRBBG installed China’s first deep-water four-pile jacket here in Sep 2020, Taisheng Lando built the 10 MW four-pile jackets, and all A-area foundation piles are only 3.0–3.5 m in diameter (jacket piles); CRBBG wrote in Nov 2021 that area A “has four-pile jackets and suction jackets”, lifting 5 deep-water suction jackets in 3 days, and Wison delivered 11 three-bucket suction jackets for areas A and C (the count of each kind was not found); 37 turbines = 14×6.7 MW + 13×8 MW + 10×10 MW (The Paper 2020-09-15, ne21 2020-11-20 and 2021-05, Baijiahao 2021-11, Wison).
CTG Fujian Changle Waihai A.dz: 澎湃（中鐵大橋局）：最大水深44 m（只有最大值）；37台：6.7 MW×14、8 MW×13、10 MW×10，無統一輪轂／葉輪。
CTG Fujian Changle Waihai A.de: The Paper (China Railway Major Bridge): maximum depth 44 m (maximum only); 37 turbines: 14 x 6.7 MW, 13 x 8 MW, 10 x 10 MW, no single hub/rotor.

Fuqing Haitan Strait.zh: 46座風機全部採嵌岩高樁承台（六樁直樁高樁承台）：華電重工2021-04-16完成46個機位全部沉樁，2021-10-02全部吊裝，2021-11-18全部並網（世紀新能源網2021-04-30、2021-10-09；廣東省水力和新能源發電工程學會轉中國電力新聞網2021-11-22）。
Fuqing Haitan Strait.en: All 46 turbines on rock-socketed high-pile caps (six vertical piles): Huadian Heavy Industry finished piling at all 46 positions on 2021-04-16, all turbines installed 2021-10-02 and grid-connected 2021-11-18 (ne21 2021-04-30 and 2021-10-09; GDSHE repost of China Electric Power News 2021-11-22).
Fuqing Haitan Strait.dz: 竣工海洋環保驗收報告：A 區水深 3.0–20.5 m、B 區 1.6–6.4 m（1985 國家高程基準）；實建機型（海裝 6.2 MW、5 MW，明陽 7.0 MW）輪轂 97／97／100.911 m、葉輪 152／152／158 m，葉輪直徑取最大機型（Power Technology 寫的 90 m 塔高與 171 m 葉輪是環評或其他機型的值，不採用）。
Fuqing Haitan Strait.de: As-built marine environmental acceptance report: zone A 3.0–20.5 m and zone B 1.6–6.4 m deep (1985 datum); the installed types (Haizhuang 6.2 MW and 5 MW, Mingyang 7.0 MW) have hubs of 97/97/100.911 m and rotors of 152/152/158 m; rotor diameter is the largest model (Power Technology’s 90 m tower and 171 m rotor are EIA-stage or other-model values and are not used).

Guangdong Energy Zhuhai Jinwan.en: All 55×5.5 MW turbines on monopiles (single steel pipe pile, 7.5–8.5 m diameter, up to 1,470 t); last foundation driven 2020-05-16, all 55 turbines grid-connected 2021-04-02 (Southcn 2020-05-17, Guangdong SASAC 2021-04-07).
Guangdong Energy Zhuhai Jinwan.dz: 水深12至21米（廣東省國資委）；明陽MySE5.5-155，葉輪直徑約155米（廣東省特種設備行業協會）
Guangdong Energy Zhuhai Jinwan.de: Water depth 12-21 m (Guangdong SASAC); Mingyang MySE5.5-155, rotor about 155 m (Guangdong special equipment association)

Guangdong Yangjiang Shaba (Guangdong Ene.zh: 47台（46台6.45MW＋1台5.5MW，中新網2021-08-31）全為導管架類基礎：A標段（廣東火電）為嵌岩與非嵌岩四樁導管架，B標段（中鐵大橋局）含植入式嵌岩三樁導管架，另有三桶吸力樁型式；2021-08-31全部風機基礎完工（世紀新能源網2020-05；中新網／微信轉載，後者無法機器核對）。各型式座數未查到。
Guangdong Yangjiang Shaba (Guangdong Ene.en: 47 turbines (46×6.45 MW + 1×5.5 MW, China News 2021-08-31), all on jacket-type foundations: lot A (Guangdong Thermal Power) used rock-socketed and non-socketed four-pile jackets, lot B (CRBBG) includes implanted rock-socketed three-pile jackets, plus a three-bucket suction type; all foundations finished 2021-08-31 (ne21 May 2020; China News via WeChat, not machine-checkable). Per-type counts not found.
Guangdong Yangjiang Shaba (Guangdong Ene.dz: 粵電陽江沙扒海域使用補充論證報告書（2023-06，陽江市自然資源局網站；項目已建 46 台 6.45 MW＋1 台 5.5 MW）：46 台 MySE6.45-180 轉輪直徑 178 m、輪轂高度 113 m，21 號機位 MySE5.5-155 預裝輪轂高度 103.6 m；依詳細地勘場址水深 25–28 m（陽西縣政府寫 23–27 m）。
Guangdong Yangjiang Shaba (Guangdong Ene.de: Guangdong Energy Yangjiang Shaba supplementary sea-use report (June 2023, Yangjiang natural resources bureau; 46 × 6.45 MW + 1 × 5.5 MW built): the 46 MySE6.45-180 have 178 m rotors and 113 m hubs, the MySE5.5-155 at position 21 a 103.6 m hub; the detailed survey gives 25–28 m of water (Yangxi county: 23–27 m).

SPIC Binhai South H3.zh: 75台4.0MW，全部採用直徑5.5–7m無過渡段鋼管樁（單樁）基礎；2020年12月9日75根樁全部沉樁完成，2020年12月底建成投產。來源：全國能源信息平台（百家號）2020-12、國家電投江蘇公司（ne21 轉載）2022-01-18。
SPIC Binhai South H3.en: 75 x 4.0 MW, all on 5.5–7 m transition-piece-free steel monopiles; all 75 piles driven by 9 Dec 2020, commissioned end of Dec 2020. Sources: National Energy Information Platform (baijiahao) Dec 2020, SPIC Jiangsu via ne21 2022-01-18.
SPIC Binhai South H3.dz: CPEM 風電人工智能大會網頁：離岸36 km、水深約18 m，75台電氣風電W4000-146（葉輪146 m）；輪轂未找到。
SPIC Binhai South H3.de: CPEM wind-AI conference page: 36 km offshore, depth about 18 m, 75 x Shanghai Electric W4000-146 (rotor 146 m); hub not found.

Jiangsu Rudong H14 (Guangheng) Offshore.zh: 如東H14為魯能新能源（中國綠發）200MW、50台4MW上海電氣機組，50根單樁基礎於2020年8月全部完工（亞洲首次大直徑單樁浮運沉樁），2020年12月全場並網。來源：南通發布（96189）2020-08-29、電力科技網 2020-07-31、新華網 2023-08-17。
Jiangsu Rudong H14 (Guangheng) Offshore.en: Rudong H14 is Luneng New Energy (China Green Development)’s 200 MW farm with 50 x 4 MW Shanghai Electric turbines; all 50 monopiles finished Aug 2020 (Asia’s first floated large-diameter monopile), fully grid-connected Dec 2020. Sources: Nantong Fabu via 96189 2020-08-29, eptchina 2020-07-31, Xinhua 2023-08-17.
Jiangsu Rudong H14 (Guangheng) Offshore.dz: 甌洋海工：魯能如東 H14 為上海電氣 SWT-4.0MW-146 首個大批量投運項目，葉輪 146 m；水深與輪轂高度未查到。
Jiangsu Rudong H14 (Guangheng) Offshore.de: Ouyang Offshore: Luneng Rudong H14 was the first large fleet of Shanghai Electric SWT-4.0MW-146 turbines, rotor 146 m; water depth and hub height not found.

Huaneng Sheyang H1 / Yancheng.zh: 華能射陽海上南區H1#300MW：67台風機，67根單樁基礎於2020年4月1日全部沉樁完成（華電重工承建其中37根），2020年11月1日67台全部吊裝完成。來源：中國華能（百家號）2020-04、中國縣域經濟報（百家號）2020-11-05。
Huaneng Sheyang H1 / Yancheng.en: Huaneng Sheyang South H1 300 MW: 67 turbines, all 67 monopiles driven by 1 Apr 2020 (37 of them by Huadian Heavy), all 67 turbines installed 1 Nov 2020. Sources: China Huaneng (baijiahao) Apr 2020, China County Economy News (baijiahao) 2020-11-05.
Huaneng Sheyang H1 / Yancheng.dz: Power Technology（射陽南區H1）：67台遠景 EN148-4.5，葉輪148米（資料庫寫6–8MW級，待查證）；水深、輪轂查無。
Huaneng Sheyang H1 / Yancheng.de: Power Technology (Sheyang South H1): 67 x Envision EN148-4.5, rotor 148 m (database says 6-8 MW class, to be checked); depth and hub not found.

Zhejiang Energy Jiaxing 1.zh: 301.2MW、74台：37台採多樁（8根1.6m鋼樁的高樁承台）基礎、37台採單樁基礎，共333根樁；2019年10月7日開始打樁，2021年10月29日74台吊裝完成，2021年11月21日全容量並網。來源：錢江晚報／潮新聞（騰訊）2021-11-21、浙江在線 2021-11-22、浙江省國資委（國資委網）2021-11-23。
Zhejiang Energy Jiaxing 1.en: 301.2 MW, 74 turbines: 37 on multi-pile (8 x 1.6 m steel piles, high-pile cap) foundations and 37 on monopiles, 333 piles in total; piling from 7 Oct 2019, all 74 turbines installed 29 Oct 2021, full capacity 21 Nov 2021. Sources: Qianjiang Evening News via Tencent 2021-11-21, zjol 2021-11-22, Zhejiang SASAC 2021-11-23.
Zhejiang Energy Jiaxing 1.dz: 錢江晚報（騰訊）：平均水深「10多米」（無確切範圍）、輪轂高度90–115 m、葉輪直徑140多–180多 m（74台多機型）；7 MW試驗機輪轂115 m、風輪186 m（國資委）；搜狐（升壓站招標公告）：場區水深8～12米；Power Technology：38台哈電 XE148-4000＋34台 SWT-4.0-146＋1台 H171，取主要機型148米。
Zhejiang Energy Jiaxing 1.de: Qianjiang Evening News (QQ): average depth 'ten-odd metres' (no exact range), hub 90–115 m, rotor 140-odd to 180-odd m across 74 turbines of several models; the 7 MW test unit has hub 115 m and rotor 186 m (SASAC); Sohu (substation tender): depth 8-12 m; Power Technology: 38 x Harbin Electric XE148-4000 + 34 x SWT-4.0-146 + 1 x H171; main model 148 m.

Zhejiang Daishan 4 Offshore wind farm.zh: 中廣核浙江岱山4#為234MW、54台（西區18台4MW、東區36台4.5MW），全場採高樁承台基礎（八樁，鋼管樁直徑1.6m；一期50台承台2020年7月澆築完成，西區144根樁2019年5月31日沉樁完成），2020年12月25日54台全容量投產。來源：全國能源信息平台（百家號）2020-07-02、浙江日報（百家號）2019-06-06、人民網浙江 2020-12-28、讀特 2020-12-25。
Zhejiang Daishan 4 Offshore wind farm.en: CGN Zhejiang Daishan 4 is 234 MW, 54 turbines (18 x 4 MW west, 36 x 4.5 MW east), all on high-pile cap foundations (8 piles of 1.6 m; 50 caps of phase 1 poured by Jul 2020, 144 west-zone piles driven by 31 May 2019); 54 turbines at full capacity 25 Dec 2020. Sources: National Energy Information Platform (baijiahao) 2020-07-02, Zhejiang Daily (baijiahao) 2019-06-06, people.cn Zhejiang 2020-12-28, dutenews 2020-12-25.
Zhejiang Daishan 4 Offshore wind farm.dz: 中國儲能網（環評招標公告）：海底高程−11.5～−15.6 m（1985國家高程基準）；岱山新聞網：實建54台、234 MW（與資料庫300 MW不同）；輪轂／葉輪未找到；Power Technology：36台遠景 EN148-4.5（32＋4）＋18台湘電 XE140-4.0，取主要機型148米；輪轂高度查無。
Zhejiang Daishan 4 Offshore wind farm.de: escn.com.cn (EIA tender): seabed elevation −11.5 to −15.6 m (1985 national datum); Daishan news: 54 turbines, 234 MW built (database says 300 MW); hub/rotor not found; Power Technology: 36 x Envision EN148-4.5 (32+4) + 18 x XEMC XE140-4.0; main model 148 m; hub not found.

SPIC Dafeng H3.zh: 大豐H3#300MW（302.4MW，72台4.2MW）由華電重工承建，合同即為「單樁與海上升壓站基礎施工」；2018年9月已完成65根單樁，同年10月22日全部72根單樁完成（東方風力發電網／北極星，無法抓取）；2018年12月20日全容量投產。來源：華電科工官網 2018-09-19、國家電投江蘇公司（ne21 轉載）2022-01-18。
SPIC Dafeng H3.en: Dafeng H3 300 MW (302.4 MW, 72 x 4.2 MW), built by Huadian Heavy Industry under a contract for ’monopile and offshore substation foundation construction’; 65 monopiles done by Sept 2018, all 72 reported done on 22 Oct 2018 (eastwp/bjx, not fetchable); full capacity 20 Dec 2018. Sources: HHI 2018-09-19, SPIC Jiangsu via ne21 2022-01-18.
SPIC Dafeng H3.dz: 華電科工（EPC）：國家電投大豐H3#300 MW場址海底高程−14～−8 m、離岸43 km（此筆實為國家電投大豐H3，非龍源／華能）；機型與輪轂未找到；Power Technology（GlobalData）：國家電投大豐H3 為72台遠景 EN136-4.2，葉輪直徑136米（與資料庫的金風/遠景4MW級描述不同，待查證機型欄）；輪轂高度查無。
SPIC Dafeng H3.de: Huadian Heavy Industries (EPC): SPIC Dafeng H3# 300 MW site seabed elevation −14 to −8 m, 43 km offshore (this record is in fact SPIC Dafeng H3, not Longyuan/Huaneng); turbine model and hub not found; Power Technology (GlobalData): SPIC Dafeng H3 has 72 x Envision EN136-4.2, rotor 136 m (database turbine field differs); hub height not found.

Guohua Dongtai IV (H2).zh: 75 台（上海電氣 4.0 MW 63 台、遠景 4.2 MW 12 台）：國家能源集團 2026-04 的招標公告寫「47#、66# 風機為高樁承台，其他為單樁基礎」，即 73 座單樁＋2 座高樁承台。先前的出處：2019-07-16「16 號單樁沉樁結束，單樁基礎施工宣告完成」（東台市委宣傳部）；2019 年 12 月全部併網（澎湃／國家能源集團）。
Guohua Dongtai IV (H2).en: 75 turbines (63 Shanghai Electric 4.0 MW and 12 Envision 4.2 MW): CHN Energy’s April 2026 tender notice says units 47# and 66# stand on high-rise pile caps and the rest on monopiles, i.e. 73 monopiles + 2 high-rise pile caps. Earlier sources: on 16 Jul 2019 “monopile no. 16 completed and monopile foundation works finished” (Dongtai propaganda dept); all units grid-connected in Dec 2019 (The Paper / CHN Energy).
Guohua Dongtai IV (H2).dz: 中交三航局（搜狐）：場址為潮間帶、露灘淺灘深溝並存、水深變化大，無數值；且該文稱63台上海電氣4.0 MW＋12台遠景4.2 MW，與資料庫「75x Goldwind GW154-4.0」不符，待查；Power Technology：一期63台上海電氣 SWT 4.0-130（葉輪130米）＋12台遠景 EN136-4.2，取主要機型130米；與資料庫「75台金風GW154」不符，待查證；水深、輪轂查無；國華東台四期（H2）招標公告：風電場水深（理論最低潮面）多在0~15 m之間，部分在理論最低潮面以上。
Guohua Dongtai IV (H2).de: CCCC Third Harbor (Sohu): intertidal site with exposed flats, shoals and channels, 'large depth variation', no figure; the article also says 63 x Shanghai Electric 4.0 MW + 12 x Envision 4.2 MW, which conflicts with the database's '75x Goldwind GW154-4.0' - to be checked; Power Technology: 63 x Shanghai Electric SWT 4.0-130 (rotor 130 m) + 12 x Envision EN136-4.2; main model 130 m; conflicts with the database's '75x Goldwind GW154'; depth and hub not found; Guohua Dongtai IV (H2) tender notice: water depth (to lowest astronomical tide) mostly 0-15 m, partly above that datum.

Huaneng Guanyun.zh: 一期300MW、48台（46台6.45MW＋2台3MW），風機基礎為單樁（2019年10月已完成10根單樁沉樁），2021年6月29日48台全部吊裝，2021年7月30日全容量並網。單樁全數完成的紀錄未抓到。來源：中國江蘇網 2019-10-16、風能產業網（CWEEA）2021-07-05、華能國際（中證網）2021。
Huaneng Guanyun.en: Phase 1: 300 MW, 48 turbines (46 x 6.45 MW + 2 x 3 MW) on monopiles (10 monopiles driven by Oct 2019); all 48 installed 29 Jun 2021, full capacity 30 Jul 2021. A record of all monopiles completed was not fetched. Sources: jschina 2019-10-16, CWEEA 2021-07-05, Huaneng Power Intl via cs.com.cn 2021.
Huaneng Guanyun.dz: 中證網（華能稿）：48台、主力機型6.45 MW、葉輪直徑184 m（金風GW184-6.45）；中廣核嵊泗 7 號環評報告書（2024）以已營運的灌雲風場作類比（2023-05 營運期水下噪聲實測），表 3.2.2-11：46 台 6.45 MW＋2 台 3.0 MW，輪轂高度 105.5 m／92 m（兩種機型，寫成範圍）；水深未找到。
Huaneng Guanyun.de: cs.com.cn (Huaneng release): 48 units, main model 6.45 MW with rotor 184 m (Goldwind GW184-6.45); the CGN Shengsi 7 EIA report (2024) uses the operating Guanyun farm as a comparison (underwater noise measured in May 2023), table 3.2.2-11: 46 × 6.45 MW + 2 × 3.0 MW with hub heights 105.5 m / 92 m (two models, given as a range); depth not found.

Huaneng Dafeng.zh: 華能江蘇大豐300MW（毛竹沙海域，離岸55km）分標段施工：中天海洋工程標段共沉樁31根（5MW級單樁，2019年8月完成）；中交一航局Ⅰ標段33根鋼管樁、34台風機（2019年8月20日沉樁完成，9月29日最後一台吊裝並網）。兩標段皆為單樁／鋼管樁，但全場機組總數與是否尚有其他標段未查得。來源：中天科技（百家號）2019、中交一航局（澎湃）2019。
Huaneng Dafeng.en: Huaneng Jiangsu Dafeng 300 MW (Maozhusha, 55 km offshore) was built in lots: Zhongtian Marine drove 31 piles (5 MW-class monopiles, done Aug 2019); CCCC First Harbour’s Lot I had 33 steel piles and 34 turbines (piling done 20 Aug 2019, last turbine 29 Sep 2019). Both lots are monopiles, but the total turbine count and whether other lots exist could not be verified. Sources: Zhongtian (baijiahao) 2019, CCCC FHEC via thepaper 2019.
Huaneng Dafeng.dz: 中天海洋工程（百家號）：毛竹沙海域灘面高程−3.3～−12.8 m、離岸55 km；澎湃報導一期為40餘台遠景4.2 MW＋20台海裝5 MW，與資料庫「75x Goldwind 4.0 MW」不符，待查；Power Technology：48台遠景 EN136-4.2＋20台中船海裝 H151-5.0，取主要機型136米（資料庫寫金風4MW，待查證）；輪轂高度查無。
Huaneng Dafeng.de: Zhongtian Marine Engineering (Baijiahao): Maozhusha site flat elevation −3.3 to −12.8 m, 55 km offshore; The Paper says phase 1 is 40-odd Envision 4.2 MW + 20 CSIC 5 MW, conflicting with the database's '75x Goldwind 4.0 MW' - to be checked; Power Technology: 48 x Envision EN136-4.2 + 20 x CSSC Haizhuang H151-5.0; main model 136 m (database says Goldwind 4 MW, to be checked); hub not found.

CGN Rudong Demonstration.zh: 38台、152MW，2016-09全場投運；採可拆卸穩樁平台浮吊沉樁，首個深水區無過渡段單樁（央廣網 2016-09-08；中國電器工業協會轉新華網 2016-09-14）；來源未明說38座全為單樁。
CGN Rudong Demonstration.en: 38 turbines, 152 MW, fully in service Sep 2016; built with a detachable pile-guide platform and floating-crane driving as the first deep-water monopiles without transition piece (CNR, 8 Sep 2016; CEEIA via Xinhua, 14 Sep 2016); the sources do not state outright that all 38 are monopiles.
CGN Rudong Demonstration.dz: 21財經（吊裝新聞）：海底高程−3.7～−15.3 m；中國電器工業協會另載−8～−14.6 m、風能產業網載最深15 m。SWT-4.0-120 的機型出處與輪轂高度未找到；英文維基百科中國離岸風場列表：38台 Siemens 4.0-120，葉輪直徑120米；輪轂高度查無。
CGN Rudong Demonstration.de: 21jingji (installation news): seabed elevation −3.7 to −15.3 m; CEEIA gives −8 to −14.6 m and cweea 'deepest 15 m'. No reachable source naming SWT-4.0-120 or the hub height; English Wikipedia list: 38 x Siemens 4.0-120, rotor 120 m; hub height not found.

CTG Pingtan Waihai.zh: 11 部試驗機組全用三樁導管架－吸力筒基礎（2022 年由四樁導管架改設計；福建省自然資源廳變更報告書）
CTG Pingtan Waihai.en: All 11 test turbines stand on three-leg jackets on suction buckets (redesigned in 2022 from four-leg piled jackets; Fujian Department of Natural Resources change report)
CTG Pingtan Waihai.dz: 變更報告書：輪轂高 114／118／130／154 m、葉輪直徑 175／185／211／252 m（依 8、10、13、16 MW 機型），海圖水深 37–38 m；國資委寫理論水深 40–43 m；葉輪直徑取最大機型
CTG Pingtan Waihai.de: Change report: hub heights 114/118/130/154 m and rotors 175/185/211/252 m for the 8, 10, 13 and 16 MW units, chart depth 37–38 m; SASAC gives 40–43 m; rotor diameter is the largest model

Xiexin (GCL) Rudong H13.zh: 中交三航局施工：30 部 5 MW 風機的單樁基礎與一座 220 kV 海上升壓站
Xiexin (GCL) Rudong H13.en: Built by CCCC Third Harbor: monopiles for the 30 × 5 MW turbines and a 220 kV offshore substation
Xiexin (GCL) Rudong H13.dz: 中國海裝：協鑫如東 H13、H15 共 70 台 H171-5MW，葉輪 171 m；場址為潮間帶淺灘，水深與輪轂高度未查到數字。
Xiexin (GCL) Rudong H13.de: CSSC Haizhuang: GCL Rudong H13 and H15 use 70 H171-5MW turbines, rotor 171 m; the site is an intertidal shoal and no depth or hub-height figure was found.

Guoneng Gongxiang (Longyuan Nanri floati.zh: 三立柱半潛式平台（立柱間距 70 m、吃水 14 m），9 套吸力錨＋錨鏈繫泊，平台下方為養殖網箱
Guoneng Gongxiang (Longyuan Nanri floati.en: Three-column semi-submersible (70 m between columns, 14 m draught) moored by nine suction anchors with chains, with a fish cage below the platform
Guoneng Gongxiang (Longyuan Nanri floati.dz: 福建省政府：離岸 30 km、水深 35 m；人民日報海外版：葉輪直徑 130 m
Guoneng Gongxiang (Longyuan Nanri floati.de: Fujian government: 30 km offshore in 35 m of water; People’s Daily overseas edition: 130 m rotor

Huaneng Shantou Lemen (II).zh: 54 部 11 MW 全部為單樁：2023 年 1 月 12 日首根（7 號機位，長 94.3 m、直徑 8–9 m、1,802 t），5 月 22 日最後一根（#1，1,836 t、長 96.1 m）沉樁完成，「全部 54 根單樁基礎沉樁施工圓滿收官」（汕頭日報經汕頭市政府、南方＋）
Huaneng Shantou Lemen (II).en: All 54 × 11 MW turbines on monopiles: the first (position 7, 94.3 m long, 8–9 m in diameter, 1,802 t) was driven on 12 January 2023 and the last (#1, 1,836 t, 96.1 m) on 22 May 2023, completing “all 54 monopile foundations” (Shantou Daily via Shantou government; Nanfang+)

SPIC Jieyang Shenquan II.zh: 50 部（16×8＋34×11 MW）全部為大直徑單樁：2022 年 11 月 17 日 50# 單樁（2,265 t、長 106 m）沉樁完成，全部 50 根單樁沉樁收官（國家電投廣東公司）
SPIC Jieyang Shenquan II.en: All 50 turbines (16 × 8 + 34 × 11 MW) on large-diameter monopiles: monopile no. 50 (2,265 t, 106 m) was driven on 17 November 2022, completing all 50 monopiles (SPIC Guangdong)

Huadian Yangjiang Qingzhou 3.zh: 67 部（37×6.8＋30×8.3 MW）用四樁套管（導管架）：設計方廣東院在首座套管吊裝時寫「風機基礎採用的是四樁導管架基礎」；一標段（中交海建）與另一施工總包（華西海工，44# 機位四根鋼管樁）都是四樁套管沉樁；2021 年 8 月已完成 38 個機位，2021 年 12 月 67 部全部併網（中國能建、世紀新能源網、陽江市生態環境局）
Huadian Yangjiang Qingzhou 3.en: 67 turbines (37 × 6.8 + 30 × 8.3 MW) on four-pile jackets: the designer GEDI wrote at the first jacket installation that “the turbine foundations are four-pile jackets”; piling reports from lot 1 (CCCC Haijian) and the other general contractor (Huaxi, four steel piles at position 44) both describe four-pile jackets; 38 positions piled by August 2021, all 67 connected by December 2021 (China Energy Engineering, ne21, Yangjiang Ecology & Environment Bureau)
Huadian Yangjiang Qingzhou 3.dz: 青洲三海域使用補充論證報告書（陽江市自然資源局 2023-01 公示；因批建不一致對實際施工的用海單元重新論證，2023-03 青洲四報告書寫青洲三已建設完成）：場址水深 41–46 m；中標機型明陽 MySE6.8-158 37 台（風輪 158 m）與 MySE8.3-180 30 台（風輪 178 m），葉輪取最大機型 178 m。同段的「預裝輪轂高度」110／115 m 是招標選型階段的文字，不採用。
Huadian Yangjiang Qingzhou 3.de: Qingzhou 3 supplementary sea-use report (Yangjiang natural resources bureau, Jan 2023; written to re-demonstrate the sea use as actually built, and the Mar 2023 Qingzhou 4 report says Qingzhou 3 is complete): site depth 41–46 m; the winning models are 37 Mingyang MySE6.8-158 (158 m rotor) and 30 MySE8.3-180 (178 m rotor), so 178 m (largest model). The same paragraph’s “pre-set hub heights” of 110 / 115 m are tender-stage wording and are not used.

Mingyang Yangjiang Qingzhou 4.zh: 44 部固定式（25×11＋19×12 MW）全部為套管（導管架）：廣州打撈局承建的 18 部 12 MW 導管架基礎 2023 年 6 月沉樁全部結束；龍源振華承攬的 25 部 11 MW 基礎由中信重工製作「導管架基礎及基礎鋼管樁」，2023 年 10 月完工；另一部是「導管架風機＋網箱」一體化裝備 MyAC-JS05；設計方廣東院稱項目採用風漁融合的一體化導管架設計（廣州日報、挖貝網、東方財富、人民網、中國能建）。明陽天成號浮式機組另列
Mingyang Yangjiang Qingzhou 4.en: All 44 fixed turbines (25 × 11 + 19 × 12 MW) on jackets: Guangzhou Salvage finished piling its 18 × 12 MW jacket foundations in June 2023; the 25 × 11 MW foundations built by Longyuan Zhenhua used “jacket foundations and pin piles” made by CITIC Heavy, completed in October 2023; one more unit is the MyAC-JS05 jacket-plus-net-cage installation; the designer GEDI describes an integrated jacket design (Guangzhou Daily, Wabei, Eastmoney, People’s Daily web, CEEC). The OceanX floating unit is recorded separately
Mingyang Yangjiang Qingzhou 4.dz: 新浪證券（2024-02-01，全容量併網，引明陽智能）：海域水深 45–47 m，44 台固定式（MySE11-230 25 台、MySE12-242 19 台）；葉輪直徑沒有另寫（明陽型號數字不一定等於直徑，不由型號推算），輪轂未查到。
Mingyang Yangjiang Qingzhou 4.de: Sina Finance (1 Feb 2024, full grid connection, citing MingYang): water depth 45–47 m, 44 fixed turbines (25 MySE11-230 and 19 MySE12-242); no separate rotor figure (MingYang model numbers are not always the diameter, so none is derived), hub not found.

SPIC Peninsula South V.zh: 70 部 7 MW＋1 部 10 MW（F14 試驗樣機）全部為單樁：竣工環境保護驗收調查報告寫「風機基礎為單樁基礎結構」，7 MW 機位單樁約 1,000 t、直徑 7.0–8.4 m，10 MW 約 1,400 t（煙台市政府公開的驗收報告；2022 年 12 月全容量併網）
SPIC Peninsula South V.en: 70 × 7 MW plus one 10 MW prototype (position F14), all on monopiles: the completion environmental acceptance report states the turbine foundations are monopiles, about 1,000 t and 7.0–8.4 m in diameter for the 7 MW units and about 1,400 t for the 10 MW unit (report published by Yantai city government; fully connected in December 2022)
SPIC Peninsula South V.dz: 竣工環境保護驗收調查報告（煙台市政府公開）：驗收階段 70 部遠景 EN200-7.0（葉輪 200 m、輪轂 117 m）＋1 部 10 MW 試驗樣機 WTD225H130（葉輪 225 m、輪轂 130 m），風電場水深 18–28 m；輪轂寫範圍、葉輪取最大機型。
SPIC Peninsula South V.de: Completion environmental acceptance report (published by Yantai city government): as accepted, 70 Envision EN200-7.0 (200 m rotor, 117 m hub) plus one 10 MW prototype WTD225H130 (225 m rotor, 130 m hub); water depth 18–28 m. Hub given as a range, rotor of the largest model.

Changle Waihai C.zh: 全為套管（導管架），分兩種：吸力式套管（紫金鋼管 2021 年 2 月首套出港時寫全場計畫布置 49 台）與四樁套管；惠生海工交付長樂外海 A、C 區共 11 座三筒吸力樁套管時寫「項目採用四樁導管架及三筒吸力樁導管架基礎」（2021-10）；各種型式的實際座數未查到
Changle Waihai C.en: All jackets, of two kinds: suction-bucket jackets (49 planned, per Zijin when the first one sailed in February 2021) and four-pile jackets; Wison, delivering 11 three-bucket suction jackets for Changle areas A and C, says the projects use “four-pile jackets and three-bucket suction jackets” (October 2021); the as-built count of each kind was not found
Changle Waihai C.dz: 海電運維招股說明書：C 區水深 31–45 m、37 部 8 MW＋20 部 10 MW，10 MW 機組輪轂中心距海平面約 120 m（約值，8 MW 機組的輪轂高度查無出處，所以不寫輪轂）；電力網 2021-10：C 區首台東方 10 MW 葉輪直徑 185 m；葉輪直徑取最大機型
Changle Waihai C.de: Fujian Haidian O&M prospectus: area C water depth 31–45 m, 37 × 8 MW + 20 × 10 MW, 10 MW hub centre about 120 m above sea level (approximate; no source for the 8 MW units’ hub, so no hub is given); chinapower.com.cn (Oct 2021): area C’s first Dongfang 10 MW unit has a 185 m rotor; rotor diameter is the largest model

SPIC Jieyang Shenquan I.zh: 一期 53 部（16×7＋37×5.5 MW，Ⅰ、Ⅱ標段）2021 年 9 月 4 日「53 根單樁全部完成沉樁」（廣州日報）；二期 13 部 7 MW 2022 年 7 月 20 日最後一根單樁完成，全部單樁沉樁收官（國家電投廣東公司、揭陽日報）；共 66 部全部為單樁
SPIC Jieyang Shenquan I.en: Phase 1, 53 turbines (16 × 7 + 37 × 5.5 MW, lots I and II): “all 53 monopiles driven” on 4 September 2021 (Guangzhou Daily); phase 2, 13 × 7 MW: the last monopile was driven on 20 July 2022, completing all its monopiles (SPIC Guangdong, Jieyang Daily); all 66 turbines on monopiles

SPIC Rudong H4.zh: 100 部 4 MW 風機各一根單樁：2021 年 10 月 24 日 H4 的 100 根基礎樁全部沉樁完成（國際能源網風電日報，2021-11）；國電投南通新能源 2026 年 7 月的運維報導寫「如東 H4、H7 海上風電項目單樁基礎及附屬構件腐蝕修復」（中國日報網）
SPIC Rudong H4.en: 100 × 4 MW turbines, one monopile each: all 100 foundation piles at H4 were driven by 24 October 2021 (in-en.com wind daily, Nov 2021); a July 2026 O&M report by SPIC Nantong New Energy describes corrosion repair of the “monopile foundations and appurtenances” of Rudong H4 and H7 (China Daily web)
SPIC Rudong H4.dz: 全國電力設備管理網（國家電投如東 800 MW 開工報導）：H4 場區中心離岸約 33 km、平均水深約 16 m（只有平均值）；輪轂高度與葉輪直徑未查到。
SPIC Rudong H4.de: CPEM (SPIC Rudong 800 MW construction report): H4 lies about 33 km offshore with an average depth of about 16 m (average only); hub height and rotor not found.

SPIC Rudong H7.zh: 100 部 4 MW 風機各一根單樁：2021 年 11 月 18 日最後一根（67 號）單樁沉樁完成，H7 的 100 根鋼管樁全部完成（國際能源網風電日報）；國電投南通新能源 2026 年 7 月的運維報導寫「如東 H4、H7 海上風電項目單樁基礎及附屬構件腐蝕修復」（中國日報網）
SPIC Rudong H7.en: 100 × 4 MW turbines, one monopile each: the last monopile (no. 67) was driven on 18 November 2021, completing all 100 steel piles of H7 (in-en.com wind daily); a July 2026 O&M report by SPIC Nantong New Energy describes corrosion repair of the “monopile foundations” of Rudong H4 and H7 (China Daily web)
SPIC Rudong H7.dz: 全國電力設備管理網：H7 場區中心離岸約 62 km、平均水深約 19 m（只有平均值）。首台風機吊裝報導的「葉片與輪轂在 95 米高空對接」是吊裝高度，不採用。
SPIC Rudong H7.de: CPEM: H7 lies about 62 km offshore with an average depth of about 19 m (average only). The first-turbine report’s “blade docked with the hub at 95 m” is an installation height and is not used.

Zhejiang Shengsi 2 Offshore wind farm.zh: 63 個機位分兩種基礎：中交三航局 31 個機位為承台（30 座高樁承台＋首樁機位 1 座混凝土承台，2021 年 8 月全部澆築完成）；中鐵大橋局 32 個機位為直徑 6–8.5 m 的大直徑單樁（B 標段 2021 年 7 月 31 日沉樁全部完成）；31 部明陽 6.45 MW＋32 部上海電氣 6.25 MW，共 399.95 MW（中國混凝土網、世紀新能源網）
Zhejiang Shengsi 2 Offshore wind farm.en: 63 positions on two foundation types: CCCC Third Harbour’s 31 positions have pile caps (30 high-rise pile caps plus one concrete cap at the first-pile position, all poured by August 2021); CRBBG’s 32 positions are 6–8.5 m monopiles (lot B piling finished on 31 July 2021); 31 Mingyang 6.45 MW + 32 Shanghai Electric 6.25 MW, 399.95 MW in all (hunningtu.com, ne21)
Zhejiang Shengsi 2 Offshore wind farm.dz: 中廣核嵊泗 7 號環評報告書（2024）以已營運的嵊泗 2 號作類比（2022-03 營運期水下噪聲實測），表 3.2.2-4／3.2.2-11：31 台 6.45 MW＋32 台 6.25 MW、輪轂高度 104 m、海域水深 9.2–12.2 m（描述已建風場，不是本場設計值）；葉輪直徑未列。
Zhejiang Shengsi 2 Offshore wind farm.de: The CGN Shengsi 7 EIA report (2024) uses the operating Shengsi 2 farm as a comparison (underwater noise measured in March 2022), tables 3.2.2-4 / 3.2.2-11: 31 × 6.45 MW + 32 × 6.25 MW, hub height 104 m, water depth 9.2–12.2 m (describing the built farm, not a design value); rotor not given.

Jiangsu Dongtai Zhugensha H2 Offshore wi.zh: 67 部（50×4.0＋17×6.0 MW）：EPC 總承包華東院 2020 年 12 月的年終報導列出「全部單樁沉樁完成」等節點，67 部風機年底前全部安裝完成；未見其他基礎型式的紀錄（只有這一個出處寫明型式）
Jiangsu Dongtai Zhugensha H2 Offshore wi.en: 67 turbines (50 × 4.0 + 17 × 6.0 MW): the EPC contractor HDEC’s year-end report (December 2020) lists “all monopile piling completed” among the milestones, with all 67 turbines installed by the end of 2020; no other foundation type is mentioned (this is the only source that names the type)

SPIC Peninsula South 3.zh: 58 部 5.2 MW 全部為鋼管單樁（平均樁重 977 t、樁長 86.4 m）；2021 年 11 月 7 日完成 58 根單樁沉樁，12 月 16 日全容量併網（世紀新能源網轉載國家電投與華電重工報導）
SPIC Peninsula South 3.en: All 58 × 5.2 MW turbines on steel monopiles (977 t and 86.4 m on average); all 58 monopiles driven by 7 November 2021, fully connected on 16 December 2021 (ne21 reposts of SPIC and Huadian Heavy Industries)
SPIC Peninsula South 3.dz: 竣工環境保護驗收意見（煙台市生態環境局，2022-05-20 驗收會；2021-12-16 完成全部 58 台風機）：調整情況對照表寫風機輪轂高度環評階段 105 m、驗收階段 99 m。葉輪直徑驗收意見沒寫（環評的遠景 5.2MW-161 是設計舉例），水深環評兩處數字不一致，都不填。
SPIC Peninsula South 3.de: Completion environmental acceptance opinion (Yantai ecology bureau, meeting of 20 May 2022; all 58 turbines completed on 16 Dec 2021): the change table gives a hub height of 105 m at the EIA stage and 99 m at acceptance. The opinion gives no rotor (the EIA’s Envision 5.2MW-161 is a design example) and the EIA’s two depth figures disagree, so neither is filled in.

Huaneng Peninsula South 4.zh: 58 部 5.2 MW 全部為單樁：最後一根單樁（58 號鋼管樁，長 97 m、直徑 7.7 m、重 1,304 t）2021 年 11 月打設完成，「國內單樁基礎水深最深的大型海上風電場之一」；2021 年 12 月 10 日 58 部全部併網（中國發展網、華能國際經中證網）
Huaneng Peninsula South 4.en: All 58 × 5.2 MW turbines on monopiles: the last monopile (pile 58, 97 m long, 7.7 m in diameter, 1,304 t) was driven in November 2021, “one of China’s large offshore farms with monopiles in the deepest water”; all 58 connected on 10 December 2021 (China Development Net; Huaneng Power International via cs.com.cn)
Huaneng Peninsula South 4.dz: 竣工環境保護驗收意見（煙台市生態環境局，2022-05-31 驗收會；2021-12 調試運行）：58 台 5.2 MW，葉輪直徑 161 m、輪轂高度 102 m（調整情況對照表：環評階段 105 m，驗收階段改為 102 m）；場區中心離岸約 30 km、水深約 30 m（約數）。澎湃新聞：遠景 EN-161/5.2 MW。
Huaneng Peninsula South 4.de: Completion environmental acceptance opinion (Yantai ecology bureau, meeting of 31 May 2022; in trial operation from Dec 2021): 58 × 5.2 MW, rotor 161 m, hub height 102 m (change table: 105 m at the EIA stage, 102 m at acceptance); site centre about 30 km offshore in about 30 m of water (approximate). The Paper: Envision EN-161/5.2 MW.

Zhejiang Jiaxing 2 Offshore wind farm.zh: 50 部 6 MW：Ⅰ標段（中交三航局）25 個機位＝11 座單樁＋14 座高樁承台，單樁 2020 年 11 月全部沉樁完成，25 部 2021 年 8 月全部完成；Ⅱ標段（中鐵大橋局）25 部為直徑 6.5–7.5 m 的大直徑單樁，2021 年 11 月全部安裝完成；合計 36 座單樁、14 座高樁承台（世紀新能源網、金山海事、工人日報）
Zhejiang Jiaxing 2 Offshore wind farm.en: 50 × 6 MW: lot I (CCCC Third Harbour), 25 positions = 11 monopiles + 14 high-rise pile caps, monopiles all driven by November 2020 and all 25 turbines completed by August 2021; lot II (CRBBG), 25 turbines on 6.5–7.5 m monopiles, all installed by November 2021; 36 monopiles and 14 pile caps in all (ne21, Jinshan MSA, Workers’ Daily)

Shanghai Fengxian.zh: 32 部 6.45 MW 全部為無過渡段單樁：中交三航局「1~32 風力發電機組工程」獲 2020–2021 年度上海市優質工程，報導寫「風電機組基礎採用無過渡段單樁基礎型式」；業主上海電力稱本案是上海周邊海域首次應用單樁基礎的海上風電項目（2021 年 12 月 28 日全部併網）
Shanghai Fengxian.en: All 32 × 6.45 MW turbines on monopiles without transition pieces: CCCC Third Harbour’s “wind turbines 1–32” works won a 2020–21 Shanghai quality award, whose citation says the turbine foundations are TP-less monopiles; the owner Shanghai Electric Power calls it the first offshore farm near Shanghai to use monopiles (all connected on 28 December 2021)

CSSC Haizhuang 'Fuyao' floating demonstr.zh: 半潛式平台，以九條對稱分布的懸垂錨鏈繫泊，機位平均水深約 65 m
CSSC Haizhuang 'Fuyao' floating demonstr.en: Semi-submersible platform held by nine symmetrically arranged catenary mooring lines, at a mean water depth of about 65 m
CSSC Haizhuang 'Fuyao' floating demonstr.dz: 水深是機位的平均水深
CSSC Haizhuang 'Fuyao' floating demonstr.de: The depth is the mean water depth at the position

Jiangsu Qidong H3 (Huawei).zh: 50 部（6 種機型，中國鐵建港航局承建，2021-10-30 最後一部安裝完成，工人日報）全為單樁：《南方能源建設》2024 年的施工論文以啟東這座規劃 304.2 MW 的海上風電場為例，寫「本項目鋼管樁共計 50 根」「共規劃建設 50 個單樁基礎」（以大申號起重船與 S-2000 液壓錘沉樁）；南通發布（世紀新能源網 2021-06）寫啟東 H1、H2、H3 三個標段合計 134 根鋼管樁、其中 H1、H2 為 84 根，134－84＝50，與 H3 的 50 部相符
Jiangsu Qidong H3 (Huawei).en: All 50 turbines (six models, built by CRCC Harbour; the last installed on 30 Oct 2021, Workers’ Daily) stand on monopiles: a 2024 construction paper in Southern Energy Construction, on the planned 304.2 MW Qidong offshore farm, says the project has 50 steel piles and 50 monopile foundations (driven with the Dashen crane barge and an S-2000 hammer); a Nantong release (ne21, June 2021) gives 134 steel piles for lots H1–H3 with 84 in H1 and H2, so 134 − 84 = 50, matching H3’s 50 turbines
Jiangsu Qidong H3 (Huawei).dz: 《南方能源建設》2024 年施工論文：場區中心離岸 37 km、水深 10–16 m（與工人日報寫的離岸約 37 km、海域 43 km² 相符）；6 種機型的輪轂高度與葉輪直徑未找到
Jiangsu Qidong H3 (Huawei).de: Southern Energy Construction (2024 construction paper): 37 km offshore, water depth 10–16 m (matching Workers’ Daily’s 37 km and 43 km²); hub heights and rotors of the six models not found

Huaneng Rudong.zh: 八仙角 70 部：38 部上海電氣 4.0 MW 與 12 部遠景 4.2 MW 為單樁，20 部重慶海裝 5.0 MW 為高樁承台（華能江蘇清潔能源 2018-11「2019 年度海上運維船租賃」招標公告，中國電力招標採購網轉載；2017-09 全部投運後）
Huaneng Rudong.en: Baxianjiao’s 70 turbines: the 38 Shanghai Electric 4.0 MW and 12 Envision 4.2 MW units stand on monopiles and the 20 CSIC Haizhuang 5.0 MW units on high-rise pile caps (Huaneng Jiangsu Clean Energy’s Nov 2018 tender for O&M vessel hire in 2019, reposted by dlztb.com; after full operation in Sept 2017)
Huaneng Rudong.dz: 中國海裝：場內 19 部 H151-5MW 與 1 部 H171-5MW，H171 風輪直徑 171 m（葉輪直徑取最大機型）；輪轂高度與水深未找到（運維招標只寫場區高程 −16.9～0.6 m，不是水深）
Huaneng Rudong.de: CSIC Haizhuang: 19 H151-5MW and 1 H171-5MW in the farm; the H171 has a 171 m rotor (largest model); hub height and depth not found (the O&M tender gives only seabed elevations of −16.9 to 0.6 m, not depth)

Jiangsu Jiangjiasha H2 Offshore wind far.zh: 67 部 4.5 MW（301.5 MW）：61 部單樁、6 部多樁導管架（國電投南通新能源 2024-06「蔣家沙 H2# 項目安全監測工作委託服務（3 年）」等運維招標，中國電力招標採購網轉載）；2018 年監測儀器採購招標寫的設計是 47 單樁＋20 三樁導管架，建成時已改
Jiangsu Jiangjiasha H2 Offshore wind far.en: 67 × 4.5 MW (301.5 MW): 61 monopiles and 6 multi-pile jackets (SPIC Nantong New Energy’s June 2024 O&M tenders, incl. three-year safety monitoring of Jiangjiasha H2#, reposted by dlztb.com); the 2018 monitoring-equipment tender gave a design of 47 monopiles + 20 three-pile jackets, changed by the time it was built

Zhejiang Taizhou 1 Offshore wind farm.zh: 浙能台州1號 40 台東方風電 DEW-D7500-204（7.5 MW）：浙江海事局 2025-03-28 公布通航要素的通告（台航通〔2025〕0033 號，項目「已建成投用」）寫 39 台採單樁基礎、1 台採「樁—桶複合基礎」；樁桶複合基礎是先打單樁、再把桶形基礎套在單樁外以負壓下沉並灌漿連接（《水道港口》2024，以台州1號為例），仍以單樁為主體，所以全場列為單樁。標段 B（中鐵大橋局）為 19 座單樁＋1 座樁桶複合基礎，標段 A 的施工通告（2022-12）也寫「單樁基礎沉樁」。
Zhejiang Taizhou 1 Offshore wind farm.en: Zheneng Taizhou 1, 40 Dongfang DEW-D7500-204 (7.5 MW): the Zhejiang MSA navigation notice of 28 Mar 2025 (Tai Hang Tong [2025] 0033, project "built and in service") says 39 turbines stand on monopiles and one on a pile–bucket composite foundation; that foundation is a driven monopile with a bucket lowered over it by suction and grouted to it (Port & Waterway Engineering 2024, on Taizhou 1), still a monopile at its core, so the whole farm is listed as monopile. Lot B (China Railway Major Bridge) was 19 monopiles + 1 pile–bucket composite, and the lot A construction notice (Dec 2022) lists monopile driving.

Tan Phu Dong 2 (Tien Giang, GEC).zh: GEC（TTC 集團）新富東2號 12 座（2021-10-30 送電，越南銀行協會）：黎蒂建設承做 PHC D800 樁打設並完成風機承台基礎，即 PHC 群樁＋承台（與新富東1號相同）。
Tan Phu Dong 2 (Tien Giang, GEC).en: GEC’s (TTC Group) Tan Phu Dong 2, 12 turbines (energised 30 Oct 2021, Vietnam Banks Association): Le Thy drove the PHC D800 piles and completed the turbine pier foundations, i.e. PHC pile group with cap (as at Tan Phu Dong 1).
Tan Phu Dong 2 (Tien Giang, GEC).dz: Power Technology：12 部 Vestas V150-4.2 MW；Vestas：葉輪直徑 150 m。水深與輪轂高度未查得。
Tan Phu Dong 2 (Tien Giang, GEC).de: Power Technology: 12 Vestas V150-4.2 MW; Vestas: 150 m rotor. Depth and hub height not found.

Jiangsu Rudong H5 (Yunshan) Offshore win.zh: 南通海事局 2020-09 施工航行通告：蘇交控如東H5#的施工內容為75台4 MW風機單樁基礎施工與75台風機安裝；2021-07 的後續通告（最後5台）施工內容同為4.0 MW風機單樁基礎。
Jiangsu Rudong H5 (Yunshan) Offshore win.en: Nantong MSA construction notice (Sept 2020): Jiangsu Communications Holding’s Rudong H5# works are 75 monopile foundations for the 4 MW turbines and installation of the 75 turbines; the July 2021 follow-up notice (last 5 units) also covers 4.0 MW monopile foundations.

Xiexin (GCL) Rudong H15.zh: 南通海事局 2020-09 與 2021-08 施工航行通告（施工單位中交三航局）：協鑫如東H15#的施工內容為40台5 MW風機單樁沉樁、附屬構件與基礎沖刷防護。
Xiexin (GCL) Rudong H15.en: Nantong MSA construction notices (Sept 2020 and Aug 2021, contractor CCCC Third Harbor): GCL Rudong H15# works are pile driving of 40 monopiles for the 5 MW turbines, appurtenances and scour protection.

Jiangsu Rudong H2 (Guoxin) Offshore wind.zh: 南通海事局 2021-06 施工航行通告：如東H2# I標段（天津港航）40個機位、II標段（龍源振華）30個機位，施工內容均為單樁沉樁、防沖刷鋪設與風機安裝；2026-02 通航安全技術參數通告（已備案）：共70台5.0 MW。
Jiangsu Rudong H2 (Guoxin) Offshore wind.en: Nantong MSA construction notices (June 2021): Rudong H2# lot I (Tianjin Port & Waterway, 40 positions) and lot II (Longyuan Zhenhua, 30 positions) both cover monopile driving, scour protection and turbine installation; the Feb 2026 navigation-parameter notice (filed after completion) gives 70 x 5.0 MW.
Jiangsu Rudong H2 (Guoxin) Offshore wind.dz: 南通海事局 2026-02 通航安全技術參數通告（已備案）：海底高程 −21～−6 m（1985國家高程基準），以此作為水深範圍；70台5.0 MW；輪轂高度與葉輪直徑未寫。
Jiangsu Rudong H2 (Guoxin) Offshore wind.de: Nantong MSA navigation-parameter notice (Feb 2026, filed after completion): seabed elevation −21 to −6 m (1985 national datum), used as the depth range; 70 x 5.0 MW; hub height and rotor diameter not stated.

Huaneng Rudong H3.en: Nantong MSA construction notices (Sept and Nov 2020): Shengdong Rudong (Huaneng) H3# has 80 x 5.0 MW in two lots of 40 (lot I: nos. 1–10, 22–29, 41–52, 61–65, 67–71; lot II: 11–21, 30–40, 53–60, 66, 72–80), both covering monopile driving and turbine installation.

Jiangsu Jiangjiasha H1 Offshore wind far.zh: 南通海事局 2020-11 施工航行通告：海安博潤新能源的蔣家沙50 MW項目施工內容為15個機位3.3 MW風機單樁基礎與風機安裝；2026-04 通告寫「禾望蔣家沙50MW風電場」機位更換葉片，已在運轉。
Jiangsu Jiangjiasha H1 Offshore wind far.en: Nantong MSA construction notice (Nov 2020): Hai’an Borun New Energy’s Jiangjiasha 50 MW works are 15 monopile foundations for 3.3 MW turbines plus installation; an Apr 2026 notice (blade replacement at the ‘Hewang Jiangjiasha 50 MW wind farm’) shows it in operation.

Huaneng Cangnan 4.zh: 77 部 5.2 MW：華能浙江公司 2025-09 為已建成風場招標的單樁基礎固化土沖刷防護工程寫明風機基礎共 77 座，42 座單樁、35 座承台（本次只做 42 座單樁）；承台由 6 根鋼管樁支撐（首座承台 2021-03，世紀新能源網），即高樁承台；溫州海事局 2025-12 通告已建成投用。
Huaneng Cangnan 4.en: 77 × 5.2 MW: Huaneng Zhejiang’s Sept 2025 tender for scour protection at the built farm states the 77 turbine foundations are 42 monopiles and 35 pile caps (the job covers the 42 monopiles); each cap stands on six steel piles (first cap, Mar 2021, ne21), i.e. high-rise pile caps; Wenzhou MSA notice (Dec 2025): built and in service.
Huaneng Cangnan 4.dz: 溫州海事局 2025-12 通航要素通告（已建成投用）：水深約 26–34 m，77 台 5.2 MW。
Huaneng Cangnan 4.de: Wenzhou MSA notice (Dec 2025, built and in service): depth about 26–34 m, 77 × 5.2 MW.

CGN Xiangshan Tuci.zh: 38 部 8 MW 全部為單樁：中廣核新能源（象山）2025-08 為已建成的象山塗茨海上風電場招標風機基礎防腐及結構檢測服務，寫明裝機 304 MW、38 部 8.0 MW，「風機基礎全部採用單樁基礎結構型式」，2022 年 10 月開工、2023 年 11 月全容量投運；寧波海事局通告已建成投用。
CGN Xiangshan Tuci.en: All 38 × 8 MW turbines on monopiles: CGN New Energy (Xiangshan)’s Aug 2025 tender for corrosion and structural inspection of the built farm’s foundations states 304 MW, 38 × 8.0 MW and that all turbine foundations are monopiles, with construction from Oct 2022 and full operation in Nov 2023; Ningbo MSA notice: built and in service.

Vindeby.zh: 世界第一座離岸風場：11 部 450 kW 坐在混凝土重力式基礎上（Ørsted 稱基礎以燈塔基礎為本，澆灌後浮運到場填砂）；2017 年 9 月拆除完畢
Vindeby.en: The world’s first offshore wind farm: 11 × 450 kW on concrete gravity-base foundations (Ørsted says they were modelled on a lighthouse foundation, floated out and filled with sand); removal completed in September 2017
Vindeby.dz: DONG Energy 2017 年拆除新聞（Power Engineering 轉載）：11 部 0.45 MW 風機葉片長 17 m、輪轂高 37.5 m；Tethys 專案頁同為輪轂 37.5 m、水深 2.1～5.1 m。葉輪直徑未填：Tethys 寫 37 m，但丹麥能源署風機登記檔（Stamdataregister，xlsx，無法以 check_quotes 核對）每部都寫 35 m、輪轂 37.5 m，兩者不一致，暫不採用。
Vindeby.de: DONG Energy's 2017 decommissioning news (reprinted by Power Engineering): the 11 × 0.45 MW turbines had 17 m blades and a 37.5 m hub height; Tethys gives the same 37.5 m hub and 2.1–5.1 m water depth. Rotor left empty: Tethys says 37 m, but the Danish Energy Agency's turbine register (Stamdataregister, an xlsx that check_quotes cannot read) gives 35 m (and a 37.5 m hub) for every unit, so the figures disagree.

Beatrice Demonstrator.zh: 2 部 5 MW 示範機立在四腳套管上（每座用四根 1.8 m 樁固定，水深約 45 m，2007 年）；油田 2015 年停產，示範機預定 2024 至 2027 年間除役
Beatrice Demonstrator.en: The two 5 MW demonstrator turbines stand on four-leg jackets (each fixed by four 1.8 m piles in about 45 m of water, 2007); the oil field closed in 2015 and the demonstrator is to be decommissioned between 2024 and 2027
Beatrice Demonstrator.dz: Beatrice 油田除役計畫書（Repsol Sinopec 等，英國政府網站，2019）描述 2007 年裝好的兩部示範風機：葉輪直徑 126 m、輪轂高於最低天文潮（LAT）88 m；兩座相同的四腳導管架位於水深 45 m。
Beatrice Demonstrator.de: Beatrice decommissioning programmes (Repsol Sinopec et al., on gov.uk, 2019) describing the two demonstrator turbines installed by 2007: 126 m rotor, hub 88 m above Lowest Astronomical Tide; the two identical four-legged jackets stand in 45 m of water.

Lely (Medemblik).zh: 荷蘭第一座離岸風場：4 部 500 kW 各立在一根單樁上（樁長 26 m、直徑 3.2–3.7 m）；2016 年底以振動錘整根拔除
Lely (Medemblik).en: The Netherlands’ first offshore wind farm: 4 × 500 kW, each on a monopile (26 m long, 3.2–3.7 m in diameter); the piles were vibrated out whole at the end of 2016
Lely (Medemblik).dz: reNEWS（2016-09，Nuon 拆除報導）：60 m 高的風機位於離岸約 750 m、水深 7～10 m 處；Maritime Danmark（2016-09）：Nedwind N40/500 兩葉風機葉輪直徑 40.77 m。輪轂高度查不到（「60 m」是總高或輪轂高未說明）。CA-OWEE 舊資料寫水深 5～10 m。
Lely (Medemblik).de: reNEWS (Sep 2016, Nuon decommissioning): the 60-metre turbines stand about 750 m from shore in 7–10 m of water; Maritime Danmark (Sep 2016): the two-bladed Nedwind N40/500 have a 40.77 m rotor. Hub height not found (the '60-metre' is not said to be hub or total height). Old CA-OWEE data give 5–10 m depth.

Yttre Stengrund.zh: 5 部 2 MW 立在單樁上；2015 年 11 月除役，單樁切至海床面（Windpower Monthly）。2006 年的潛水調查（Wilhelmsson 等）與瑞典環保署報告也寫鋼製單樁；Vattenfall 2016 年新聞稿說「把混凝土基礎切至海床面」，應指單樁裡的灌漿或混凝土填充，不改型式
Yttre Stengrund.en: 5 × 2 MW on monopiles; decommissioned in November 2015 with the monopiles cut down to seabed level (Windpower Monthly). A 2006 diver survey (Wilhelmsson et al.) and a Swedish EPA report also describe steel monopiles; Vattenfall’s 2016 release about cutting “the concrete foundations” presumably means the grout or concrete fill of the piles, so the type is unchanged
Yttre Stengrund.dz: CA-OWEE（歐盟 Concerted Action on Offshore Wind Energy in Europe 的離岸風場資料庫，offshorewindenergy.org，標示「運轉中」）：Yttre Stengrund 5 部 NEG-Micon 2 MW、離岸 5 km、水深 6～10 m，風機為 72 m 葉輪、60 m 輪轂、變槳控制。出處是 2002–2008 年維護的研究資料庫（不是業主文件）；同資料庫的 Utgrunden、Blyth、Vindeby 水深與其他出處相符。
Yttre Stengrund.de: CA-OWEE (the EU Concerted Action on Offshore Wind Energy in Europe database at offshorewindenergy.org, status 'In operation'): Yttre Stengrund's 5 NEG-Micon 2 MW turbines, 5 km from shore in 6–10 m of water, '72 m rotor diameter, 60 m hub, pitch regulated'. The source is a research database maintained 2002–2008 (not an owner document). Its depths for Utgrunden, Blyth and Vindeby agree with other sources.

Empire wind farm.zh: 54 座單樁（Sif 製）配轉接段，2025 年夏秋安裝（海上變電站立在套管上）
Empire wind farm.en: 54 monopiles (made by Sif) with transition pieces, installed in summer and autumn 2025 (the offshore substation stands on a jacket)

Sunrise Wind.zh: 84 座風機單樁（2025 年年中開始安裝，2026 年 8 月已裝好 77 座）；海上變流站另為一座構造
Sunrise Wind.en: 84 turbine monopiles (installation started in mid-2025; 77 were in place by August 2026); the offshore converter station is a separate structure

Frederikshavn: 試驗場：2003 年在海上設 3 部，港口擴建後只剩 Nordex N90/2300 一部在海上（丹麥能源署、OpenStreetMap）；Nordex 2003 年只寫「以板樁與樁固定在海床上的重型基礎」，型式無法歸類，OSPAR 寫全為單樁、14 MW 也對不上，先不列

A test site: 3 turbines at sea from 2003; after the harbour extension only the Nordex N90/2300 is left at sea (Danish Energy Agency, OpenStreetMap). Nordex only said in 2003 that it stands on “a heavy-duty foundation tied to the seabed by means of planking and piles”, which fits no type here, and OSPAR’s “all monopiles” and 14 MW do not match, so it is left out
Eurus Akita Port semi-offshore: JWPA 另計為「セミ洋上」的 1 部 3 MW：ユーラス秋田港ウインドファーム（6 部 3 MW，2015 年 2 月運轉）中立在水中的那一部；查不到業主、施工廠商、NEDO、國土交通省或 JWPA 的文件寫出它的基礎型式

The single 3 MW unit that JWPA counts as “semi-offshore”: the one turbine standing in the water at Eurus Akita Port Wind Farm (six 3 MW turbines, operating since February 2015); no document from the owner, the contractors, NEDO, MLIT or JWPA was found that gives its foundation type
Yeonggwang Wind offshore wind farm: 靈光風電陸海混合風場（35 部、79.6 MW）中立在潮間帶的 15 部 2.3 MW，退潮時周圍是灘地；查不到開發商、施工廠商或政府文件寫出這 15 部的基礎型式

The 15 × 2.3 MW turbines of the Yeonggwang Wind onshore-and-offshore complex (35 turbines, 79.6 MW) that stand in the intertidal zone, dry at low tide; no developer, contractor or government statement of their foundation type was found
